title: DTC Video Editor
description:
As a DTC Video Editor, you will be responsible for transforming raw footage, UGC submissions, brand assets, and scripts into high-impact, conversion-focused ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google,
 campaigns, and website placements.



This role requires a powerful blend of storytelling, design, and performance marketing, ensuring every asset you produce is optimized to stop the scroll, drive engagement, and convert.



You will collaborate closely with DTC Strategists, UGC Creators, Designers, Paid Media Specialists, and Project Managers to deliver high-volume creative on tight deadlines.



Key Responsibilities:

- Edit high-performing video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google, and other acquisition channels.

- Produce multiple creative variations for A/B testing (hooks, CTAs, pacing, captions, formats).

- Incorporate brand typography, motion graphics, sound design, and on-screen captions.

- Build dynamic ad iterations influenced by performance insights (CTR, thumb-stop, CVR).

- Edit UGC content, product demos, testimonial videos, and creator submissions.

- Partner with DTC Strategists to interpret creative briefs, ad frameworks, and storyboards.

- Work with UGC creators and internal teams to assemble raw content into polished ads.

- Maintain creative consistency and brand adherence across all clients and assets.

- Implement creative learnings, such as pacing adjustments and stronger opening hooks.

- Manage multiple clients and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.-

- Track deliverables, revisions, and creative requests using tools like Airtable, Asana, or Notion.



Qualifications:

- Proven experience as a Video Editor with strong performance-ad portfolio (Meta/TikTok/YT).

- Proficiency in editing tools: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, etc.

- Experience in creating DTC, UGC, or e-commerce-focused video ads.

- Ability to understand marketing metrics and translate them into creative decisions.

- Skilled in typography, motion graphics, color grading, pacing, and sound design.

- Knowledge of Airtable, Asana, or Notion for project management.

- Strong communication, adaptability, and team collaboration.

- Thrives in high-pressure, high-output creative environments.

• Competitive salary base

• Work schedule is in EST (Monday-Friday only)

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

title: Canva Product Video Editor
description:
About Us:



We are a rapidly growing marketing agency from Germany, recognized as a market leader in our field. Our team is young, motivated, and passionate about producing outstanding content. We specialize in creating high-quality product videos for online shops and Amazon product pages. As we continue to expand, we're looking for Remote Canva Video Editors to join our team for a long-term commitment.





Job Description:



We are looking for motivated Remote Canva Video Editors to edit product videos for our clients. You will be provided with all the raw material and a detailed video script for each project.



For this role, you will work exclusively with the Canva Video Editor. Experience with professional video editing tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Photoshop is a plus, but it is not required.



This position is also suitable for career changers, virtual assistants, or people who are interested in getting into video editing and are excited about creating product videos on a daily basis. The most important thing is that you have a strong sense of aesthetics and a good eye for creating beautiful, clean, and engaging videos.



We will teach you exactly how to use the Canva Video Editor and how to edit product videos according to our standards. The role is entirely remote and requires a high-speed internet connection for efficient uploads and downloads.





Training:



To ensure you're set up for success, we provide a course on editing product videos with Canva, created by our team. Watching and learning from this course marks the beginning of our collaboration.





Trial Period:



The first week is a paid trial phase, where you'll go through our course and complete a test project. If the quality meets our standards, we will proceed with a permanent employment offer.





Requirements:



• Strong aesthetic sense and good design understanding

• Motivation to edit product videos on a daily basis

• Ability to follow clear instructions and processes

• Good English skills

• Experience with Canva is a plus, but not required

• Experience in video editing is a plus, but not required

• Experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, or other editing software is a plus, but not required

• Interested in a full-time role, 40 hours per week, and looking for long-term employment, ideally for several years





How to Apply:



Please submit your application with the subject "Canva-Video-Candidate" and include videos or visual work samples of your previous work, if available.



If you do not have previous video editing work yet, you can also apply by telling us why you are interested in becoming a Canva Video Editor and why you think you have a good eye for aesthetics and visual content.





Traits We Value:



• Good eye for aesthetics and visual details

• Ability to follow clear instructions and processes

• Discipline and determination

• Eagerness to create amazing product videos

• Motivation to learn and improve every day

• Reliability and long-term commitment





Benefits:



• Paid time off and paid holidays

• 13th-month pay

• Annual performance-based salary bonus/increases

• Internal training with exclusive knowledge

• Long-term remote position

• Opportunity to learn a highly valuable creative skill





Join Us:



If you're motivated to create beautiful product videos, have a strong sense of aesthetics, and are looking for a long-term, fulfilling career, we'd love to hear from you.



You do not need to be a full professional yet. What matters most is your motivation, your visual understanding, and your willingness to learn our process and work with Canva every day.



Apply today to become a part of our success story!

Fluent in written and spoken English

Excellent grammar and communication skills

Extremely detail-oriented

Organised and reliable

Proactive and willing to learn

Creative and have a good eye for aesthetics

Comfortable working with technology and online platforms

Comfortable asking questions when something isn't clear

Someone who takes pride in producing professional, high-quality work

✔ Spelling and grammar

Virtual assistance

Canva

 marketing

Meta Business Suite

Instagram &

CRM systems

Online booking systems

Digital marketing

Launching online programs or memberships



Beauty industry experience is a bonus but not essential.

We are a growing beauty business transitioning into a stronger education and online academy model, with the goal of creating professional, high-quality online beauty education.

There is potential for this to become an ongoing position with increased hours and responsibility as the academy grows.

A brief introduction about yourself

The platforms and software you are confident using

Examples of previous work, if available

Your hourly rate

title: Client Account Manager (Remote)
description:
About the Company: 

Ninedot is a US-based digital agency specializing in web development, SEO, HubSpot, AI visibility, and digital marketing solutions. We help businesses grow through strategic digital services and long-term client partnerships.



About the Role:



We're looking for an experienced Client Account Manager to manage client relationships, coordinate with internal teams, and ensure excellent service delivery.



You'll serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing communication, expectations, project updates, and account growth opportunities. Working hours is from 9AM-5PM EST. (9PM to 5AM PH Time)



Key Responsibilities



- Manage client relationships from initial discovery through project completion and ongoing support.

- Lead client meetings, provide updates, and ensure timely follow-ups.

- Coordinate with project managers and delivery teams to keep client requests on track.

- Review proposals, statements of work (SOWs), estimates, and client communications.

- Monitor project scope, retainer hours, and client satisfaction.

- Identify potential issues, escalate concerns, and coordinate resolutions.

- Identify opportunities for additional services and account growth.

- Maintain accurate client records and ensure clear communication across teams.



Qualifications:

- At least 3 years of client account management experience in an agency or service-based company.

- Experience managing 10+ client accounts simultaneously.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Experience with client discovery calls, proposals, SOWs, and change requests.

- Familiarity with websites, WordPress, HubSpot, SEO, and digital marketing.

- Strong organizational, problem-solving, and relationship-management skills.

- Comfortable handling challenging client conversations.

- Ability to work consistently during US Eastern Time business hours.



Preferred: Experience with Teamwork, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Fireflies, Read AI, and white-label agency partnerships.



How to Apply:

Please use the exact subject line: CAM for Webdev



In the body of your message, briefly describe your experience in client account management, particularly in web development or digital marketing agencies. Include your experience managing multiple client accounts and handling challenging client situations.



We will review all applications and shortlist qualified candidates. Shortlisted applicants will receive a calendar booking link to schedule their initial interview.



Important: Applications that do not follow the required subject line will not be considered.

title: $12,000 From ONE Partnership - Need Crypto Network, Not Experience (Remote BD)
description:
We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.



Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. No ceiling.



Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):



Mints $50,000 in bonds: $1,500 launch bonus paid as it happens, plus 20% of every upgrade fee as they roll in

Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



That's ONE introduction. Land three and run the math.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗛𝗔𝗩𝗘:



Existing connections in crypto (launchpads, DEXs, chains, established projects)

/
 relationships with project founders or marketing heads

Understanding of DeFi/crypto space

Hunger to earn based on results, not hours



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗗𝗢𝗡'𝗧 𝗡𝗘𝗘𝗗:



To close deals (I handle that)

Any upfront investment

Previous BD experience (connections matter more)



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘:



Your job is booking qualified calls. You reach into your network, find decision-makers at crypto projects, and get them on a scheduled call with me. I close the deals, you collect appointment bonuses, commissions, and launch bonuses as your partnerships go live and grow.



Ready to turn your crypto connections into serious income?

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,

title: Senior DTC Creative Strategist (Pet Wellness / Supplements)
description:
About Us

We are a growing, fast-paced pet wellness brand operating directly on Shopify, dedicated to improving our pets’ quality of life through high-efficacy, premium supplements. We are past the ground floor and scaling rapidly. We don't guess what converts we research, test, iterate, and win through creative excellence.



The Role

We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and highly imaginative Senior Creative Strategist. This is NOT an entry-level position. You should already have a proven track record conceptualizing top-of-funnel and mid-funnel direct-response video creative for DTC e-commerce brands (pet, health, or wellness brand experience is a massive plus).



You will own our creative roadmap: finding untapped customer angles, scripting and storyboarding high-impact hooks/concepts, collaborating hand-in-hand with our video editors, and reporting actionable performance insights back to leadership and media buyers.



What You’ll Do

Angle & Hook Development: Uncover non-obvious consumer psychology, pain points, and desires of pet parents. Think outside the box to craft novel hooks, visual metaphors, demonstrations, and objection-handling narratives that stop the scroll.



Hands-on Production Briefing: Write detailed direct-response video scripts, shot lists, and visual storyboards (UGC style, founder-led, product demos, 2D motion graphics).



Editor Collaboration: Work directly and collaboratively with video editors in the trenches—giving precise time-coded feedback, pacing guidance, visual direction, and creative iteration suggestions.



Analyze & Report: Conduct weekly post-mortem and performance reviews on creative metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS, CPA). Turn quantitative ad data into actionable next steps and report key insights back to the core team.



Iteration Engine: Systematically test winning creative variations (swapping hooks, tweaking CTA pacing, re-ordering proof points) to extend creative lifespan and maximize spend efficiency.



Competitor & Trend Forensics: Continuously monitor the DTC landscape, TikTok/Meta trends, and pet supplement competitors to keep our brand ahead of creative fatigue.



Who You Are (Requirements)

Proven Experience: 2–4+ years of dedicated DTC Creative Strategist experience running high-spend Meta and TikTok ad accounts for consumer brands.



Pet Industry / Health Niche Intuition: Deep familiarity with pet wellness or human supplement messaging, compliance boundaries, and what triggers trust and emotional conversion in pet owners.



Strong Direct-Response Chops: You master fundamental DR metrics (3-second thumbstop/hook rate, 25%/50% watch time, conversion rates) and know how to diagnose creative failure points.



Collaborative Editor Partner: You speak the language of video editing (pacing, cuts, B-roll selection, sound design, on-screen text hierarchy) and know how to give constructive, actionable creative direction.



Self-Directed & Accountable: You don’t wait for direction; you bring fresh angles, pitches, and testing roadmaps to every sprint.



Bonus Points If You:

Have worked on an active Shopify brand scaling past 7 or 8 figures.



Have direct experience managing UGC creators, sourcing raw footage, or directing remote shoots.



Understand organic-to-paid creative transitions on TikTok / Instagram Reels.



How to Apply

title: Growth & Community Outreach Specialist (SaaS / Open Source)
description:
Postmill AI is an early-stage technology company building an open-source, AI-native social media management platform.



Our platform helps businesses, marketers, creators, and agencies manage their social media presence across 45+ channels, with tools for content creation, scheduling, analytics, engagement, AI-powered automation, and media generation.



Unlike traditional social media management platforms, Postmill is open-source and available as both a self-hosted application and a cloud-hosted service.



We're a small, growing team with an ambitious vision, and we're looking for someone who wants to help us build something meaningful.



Learn more:



Website: 



GitHub: 



About the Role



We're looking for a motivated, creative, and resourceful Growth & Community Outreach Specialist to help introduce Postmill AI to the people and businesses who would benefit from it.



This isn't a traditional social media management position.



We're not looking for someone to simply publish posts, manage a content calendar, or generate hundreds of low-quality backlinks.



We want someone who understands how to find relevant audiences, build relationships, create opportunities, and turn awareness into actual product adoption.



You'll work directly with the founder, helping develop and execute organic growth initiatives across communities, websites, social networks, and potential partnerships.



Because we're an early-stage startup, you'll have the opportunity to contribute ideas, experiment with approaches, and play an important role in shaping our growth strategy.



Key Responsibilities



Organic Growth & Customer Acquisition



Research and identify potential Postmill users, including businesses, creators, marketers, and software enthusiasts.



Discover communities, websites, publications, and conversations where Postmill would be relevant.



Develop and execute targeted outreach campaigns to introduce Postmill to prospective users.



Identify opportunities to increase product awareness, website traffic, registrations, and adoption.



Community Engagement



Participate in relevant conversations on LinkedIn, X, GitHub, Reddit, forums, and other online communities.



Build genuine relationships with potential customers, industry professionals, and community members.



Share useful information, answer questions, and introduce Postmill where appropriate.



Help establish Postmill as a recognizable and trusted name in open-source software and social media management.



SEO & Link Building



Identify relevant opportunities for legitimate backlinks, product listings, reviews, and editorial mentions.



Research and contact bloggers, software reviewers, publications, and website owners.



Submit Postmill to reputable software directories and open-source project listings.



Help improve organic search visibility through ethical, high-quality off-page SEO.



Partnerships & Outreach



Identify potential relationships with creators, educators, consultants, software reviewers, and complementary technology companies.



Research partnership opportunities and coordinate initial outreach.



Help generate product reviews, tutorials, demonstrations, and third-party recommendations.



Research, Reporting & Optimization



Track outreach activities, responses, referrals, and resulting traffic or registrations.



Evaluate which channels and approaches produce meaningful results.



Recommend improvements based on performance and feedback.



Provide concise weekly progress reports, including results, challenges, and upcoming priorities.



What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



Demonstrated experience in organic marketing, digital outreach, SEO, community growth, or customer acquisition.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong research skills and the ability to identify relevant, high-quality opportunities.



Experience conducting personalized outreach and developing professional relationships.



Understanding of SEO fundamentals and ethical link-building practices.



Comfortable using analytics, spreadsheets, and online research tools.



Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and communicate progress.



Strong attention to detail, professionalism, and follow-through.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience marketing SaaS products, technology platforms, or online software services.



Familiarity with GitHub, open-source software, or developer communities.



Experience with LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and relevant professional communities.



Experience with organic customer acquisition and conversion tracking.



Familiarity with AI tools and marketing automation.



Basic graphic design, video editing, or content creation skills.



You do not need to be a software developer or an expert in artificial intelligence. However, you should be curious about technology and willing to learn how our product works.



The Person We're Hoping to Find



Skills and experience are important, but we're equally interested in finding someone who will be a great long-term addition to our team.



Our ideal candidate is:



Proactive: You identify opportunities rather than waiting to be assigned every task.



Resourceful: You can find creative solutions, especially when budgets are limited.



Curious: You enjoy learning new technologies, products, and marketing approaches.



Communicative: You share your ideas, explain your reasoning, and provide regular updates.



Accountable: You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.



Collaborative: You welcome feedback and enjoy working with others.



Results-oriented: You care more about meaningful outcomes than simply completing activities.



We don't expect you to know everything. We value people who ask thoughtful questions, learn quickly, and genuinely care about doing good work.



Compensation & Benefits



Base Salary: $1,250 USD per month.



Performance Commissions: Additional compensation for attributable paid subscriptions and other agreed growth outcomes.



Long-Term Opportunity: We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, not a short-term freelancer.



Remote Work: Work from home in the Philippines.



Direct Founder Access: Work directly with the founder and contribute to important business decisions.



Modern Tools: Access to Postmill AI and the tools necessary to perform your role.



Specific commission terms will be discussed during the hiring process.



How to Apply



Please send your résumé or professional background along with answers to the following questions.



1. Previous Results



Describe an organic marketing, outreach, or growth campaign you personally worked on. What was your role, what actions did you take, and what measurable results did you achieve?



2. Outreach Experience



Describe how you've successfully earned a backlink, secured a product mention, developed a partnership, or attracted potential customers through outreach. Please include an example if possible.



3. Your Approach to Postmill



Take a few minutes to visit 
.



Based on your initial understanding, who do you think would benefit most from Postmill, and where would you begin looking for those potential users?



4. Initiative



Tell us about a time you identified an opportunity or solved a problem without being asked. What happened?



5. Your Motivation



What interests you about this position, and why do you think you'd be a good fit for a small, growing technology company?



Please provide thoughtful answers in your own words. We're not looking for lengthy essays or generic AI-generated responses. We want to understand your experience, judgment, communication style, and how you approach problems.



Our Hiring Process



We'll review applications and select a small number of candidates for interviews.

We value your time and believe candidates should be compensated for meaningful work performed during the evaluation process.

description:

MindDiary is an early-stage practice management platform built for therapists and counsellors in Ireland and the UK. It helps practitioners manage enquiries, client intake, appointments, notes, payments and between-session engagement in one place.

• Contact prospects through personalised email, LinkedIn and phone outreach

• Have professional and friendly conversations with potential customers

• Follow up consistently with prospects and demo attendees

• Strong spoken and written English

• Confident and professional communication over email, phone and video calls

• Experience in business development, sales, appointment setting, lead generation or customer service

• Comfortable initiating conversations with new prospects and handling rejection professionally

• Able to personalise outreach instead of sending generic mass messages

• Strong research, organisation and follow-up skills

• Dependable, self-motivated and comfortable working independently

• Willing to learn the MindDiary product and understand the needs of therapists

• Available full-time with substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours

• Reliable internet connection, working computer and a quiet environment for calls



Nice to have



• Experience selling SaaS or other online services

• Experience working with healthcare, therapy, wellness or professional-services businesses

• Familiarity with CRM systems, LinkedIn prospecting and cold
 tools

• Previous experience working remotely with an international company

• Experience supporting customer onboarding or delivering software demonstrations



Working hours



This is a full-time remote position requiring 40 hours per week. Your schedule must include substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours because prospects will be contacted during their working day.



Compensation



• US$500 per month

• Additional performance bonuses based on qualified demonstrations and paying customers

• Long-term opportunity with compensation reviews as MindDiary grows



How success will be measured



• Suitable prospects researched and contacted

• Quality and personalisation of outreach

• Positive responses and qualified conversations

• Product demonstrations scheduled and attended

• Consistency and quality of follow-ups

• Paying customers generated

• Accuracy of CRM records and weekly reporting



How to apply



Please include the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience

2. An example of how you previously generated leads, meetings or customers

3. A 60–90 second voice or video introduction

4. A short sample message you would send to an independent therapist in Ireland to introduce MindDiary

5. Your availability in Irish time

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the US$500 monthly salary



Please personalise your application and mention MindDiary. Generic applications that do not address the role will not be considered.

Create
 campaigns for opted-in customers and catering contacts.

Required Marketing Strategy, ROI, and Conversion Reporting

Weekly updates: Report campaign progress, spending, conversion updates, completed work, upcoming priorities, and decisions needed.



Monthly marketing and strategy report: Compare results against goals and budget, summarize channel performance, and recommend specific improvements.



Revenue and returns: Report attributable revenue and return on ad spend (ROAS). Calculate marketing ROI when sufficient revenue and cost data is available, clearly explaining the method and assumptions.



Conversion reporting: Track completed orders, catering inquiries, confirmed bookings, promotional redemptions, and rewards enrollments separately.



Conversion efficiency: Report conversion rates, cost per conversion, customer acquisition cost, and inquiry-to-booking rates where measurable.



Channel analysis: Evaluate paid advertising, social media, SEO, GEO/AI search,
, proximity marketing, and reviews using available evidence.



Strategic recommendations: Identify which campaigns to continue, improve, pause, or expand, supported by results.



Reporting accuracy: Distinguish actual results from estimates, identify attribution gaps, and avoid counting the same sale more than once. Clicks, engagement, and inquiries must not be presented as completed sales.

Marketing Coordination

Communicate blockers early and follow through without constant reminders.

 marketing, customer retention, or Toast.

title: NDIS HR & Compliance Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a proactive, confident, and experienced HR & Compliance Coordinator to support our NDIS organisation with hands-on HR coordination, employee relations, and compliance administration.



Reporting directly to the General Manager, you will oversee key HR processes, coordinate employee performance and disciplinary matters, maintain accurate records, and help ensure workforce-related requirements are met in accordance with organisational policies and applicable NDIS requirements.



This is a hands-on role for someone who is confident managing sensitive employee matters, coordinating performance management processes, and ensuring HR and compliance tasks are completed within required timeframes.



The successful candidate must be proactive, highly organised, and capable of working autonomously. You should be comfortable identifying issues, taking appropriate action, following matters through to completion, and keeping the General Manager informed without requiring constant direction.



Key Responsibilities

1. HR Support & Employee Relations

Provide day-to-day HR support to the General Manager and management team.

Coordinate employee feedback and performance management processes.

Maintain the HR feedback register and ensure matters are documented and followed up promptly.

Coordinate informal performance discussions and follow-up communications.

Support formal performance and disciplinary processes, including letters of concern, disciplinary meetings, written warnings, and termination processes where appropriate.

Participate in or facilitate employee meetings relating to performance, conduct, and workplace concerns.

Assist managers with employee relations issues, conflict resolution, and workplace concerns.

Maintain professional communication and confidentiality when managing sensitive employee matters.

2. HR Administration & NDIS Compliance

Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR records, registers, and employee documentation.

Monitor employee compliance requirements relevant to the organisation's NDIS operations.

Coordinate and track worker screening and other applicable employment eligibility requirements.

Monitor mandatory training, qualifications, certifications, and other required employee documentation.

Follow up on expiring documents, outstanding requirements, and compliance gaps.

Coordinate employee acknowledgements of HR policies, procedures, and organisational communications.

Assist with implementing and maintaining HR policies and procedures.

Support workforce-related audit preparation and compliance documentation.

Liaise with external HR advisors and relevant stakeholders when guidance is required.

Escalate compliance risks and outstanding matters to the General Manager promptly.

3. Workers' Compensation & Workplace Matters

Coordinate workers' compensation matters and associated administration.

Liaise with relevant insurers, claims managers, and other stakeholders.

Maintain the workers' compensation register and monitor outstanding actions.

Ensure claims and related documentation are accurately recorded and followed up.

Assist with coordinating workplace i
-related HR actions where required.

4. HR Registers, Reporting & Follow-Through

Maintain accurate HR and compliance tracking registers.

Monitor outstanding actions, deadlines, and employee documentation.

Provide regular updates to the General Manager on open HR matters and compliance requirements.

Identify gaps, follow up proactively, and ensure actions are completed within required timeframes.

Support continuous improvement of HR administration and workforce compliance processes.

Key Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will:



Take ownership of HR and compliance matters from start to finish.

Proactively identify outstanding tasks and act without waiting for repeated instructions.

Maintain accurate records and ensure deadlines are met.

Confidently coordinate employee performance and disciplinary processes.

Monitor workforce compliance requirements relevant to NDIS operations.

Escalate sensitive HR issues and compliance risks appropriately.

Communicate clearly and consistently with the General Manager.

Demonstrate sound judgement, discretion, and confidentiality.

Work independently and respond constructively to feedback.

Ensure outstanding matters are tracked, followed up, and closed out appropriately.



About You



We are looking for someone with experience in HR coordination, employee relations, and compliance administration, ideally within the NDIS, disability support, aged care, or another regulated care environment.



You will ideally have:



Experience in HR coordination, HR administration, or employee relations.

Confidence managing performance management and disciplinary processes.

Familiarity with NDIS workforce compliance requirements.

Experience maintaining employee records, compliance registers, and supporting documentation.

Understanding of worker screening, mandatory training, and qualification tracking.

Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The confidence to handle sensitive employee conversations professionally.

The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.

A proactive, solutions-focused approach.

The ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgement.

What We Are Looking For



This is not simply an administrative HR position. We need someone who can confidently manage employee relations matters while ensuring HR and workforce compliance tasks are consistently monitored and completed.



The ideal candidate can identify an issue, determine the next steps, take action, follow up with the relevant people, and keep the General Manager informed without requiring constant reminders.



You should be comfortable balancing HR administration, employee relations, and compliance tracking in a regulated disability support environment.



Working Arrangement



This is a remote role. The successful candidate must demonstrate accountability, responsiveness, strong communication, and the ability to manage their workload independently.



Performance will be measured by the ability to keep HR matters progressing, meet deadlines, maintain accurate records, monitor workforce compliance requirements, and proactively manage responsibilities.



If you are an experienced NDIS HR professional who takes ownership, communicates confidently, and understands the importance of workforce compliance in the disability support sector, we encourage you to apply.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA – Cold Calling & Follow-Up
description:
Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA – Inbound & Outbound Lead Follow-Up

Xpert Realty Group is looking for a dependable, organized, and confident Real Estate Lead Manager / Inside Sales Assistant (ISA) to manage incoming real estate leads, conduct outbound prospecting, consistently follow up with prospects, and schedule qualified appointments for our broker and agents.

This is not a general administrative VA position. Your primary responsibility will be helping us make sure no legitimate real estate opportunity falls through the cracks.

You will work primarily inside Lofty CRM and serve as the first point of contact for many new buyer and seller leads.

What You’ll Do

- Monitor Lofty during your assigned work hours for new inbound leads

- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and

- Call and follow up with older leads already in our database

- Make outbound prospecting calls to potential sellers

- Work buyer and seller internet leads

- Contact expired listings, FSBOs, absentee owners, distressed-property prospects, cash-offer leads, and other seller opportunities

- Qualify leads by determining their motivation, timeline, property situation, and real estate needs

- Schedule qualified appointments for the broker or assigned agent

- Immediately escalate hot or time-sensitive opportunities

- Follow our scripts and processes while still sounding natural and conversational

- Professionally handle common objections

- Accurately document every meaningful conversation in Lofty

- Update lead status, tags, notes, follow-up dates, and tasks

- Place leads into the appropriate follow-up or nurture process

- Continue nurturing prospects who are not ready today but may buy or sell later

- Help maintain a clean, organized CRM database

- Attend training, coaching, and roleplay sessions

- Track daily activity and weekly results

Inbound Lead Responsibilities

Speed-to-lead is important to this position.

When a new lead enters Lofty during your assigned working hours, you will be expected to quickly begin the appropriate contact process.

This may include:

Call → Text →
 → Qualify → Document → Schedule or Nurture

You should be comfortable communicating with people who have recently requested information as well as prospects who may require multiple follow-up attempts before responding.

Outbound Lead Responsibilities

You will also proactively contact prospects who have not recently requested information.

These may include:

- Older CRM leads

- Expired listings

- FSBOs

- Absentee owners

- Tired landlords

- Pre-foreclosure/distressed-property leads

- Cash-offer prospects

- Homeowners identified through prospecting lists

You must be comfortable making outbound calls and hearing “no” without becoming discouraged.

What We Are Looking For

You should be:

- Reliable

- Persistent

- Organized

- Coachable

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners

- Confident on the telephone

- Professional and friendly

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with repetitive follow-up

- Able to work independently

- Able to follow a defined process

- Comfortable being measured by results

Strong spoken and written English is required.

You do not need an American accent, but homeowners must be able to clearly and comfortably understand you.

CRM Discipline Is Extremely Important

Every lead interaction should result in accurate CRM documentation.

We expect meaningful notes—not simply:

“Called lead.”

A good CRM note should explain what happened and what should happen next.

For example:

“Seller may relocate in approximately 3 months. Home needs some repairs. Interested in learning retail value and may consider a cash offer. Follow up Nov. 15.”

Technical Requirements

You must have:

- Reliable computer

- Minimum 8 GB RAM; 16 GB preferred

- Stable high-speed internet

- Backup internet connection or mobile hotspot

- Quality noise-canceling headset

- Webcam

- Quiet professional workspace

- Backup plan for internet or power interruptions

Preferred Experience

Previous experience with real estate, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, inside sales, or customer service is strongly preferred.

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

- Lofty / Chime

- Follow Up Boss

- Real estate investing

- Real estate wholesaling

- Seller lead generation

- Buyer internet leads

- Expired listings

- FSBO prospecting

- Cash-offer campaigns

Lofty experience is preferred but not required. We can train the right candidate.

Schedule

Part-Time – 20 hours per week

Approximately:

4 hours per day / 5 days per week

You must be available during agreed U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

There may be an opportunity for increased hours and responsibility based on performance.

Compensation

$5 USD per hour + performance-based bonus opportunities

Long-term growth opportunities are available for a candidate who consistently performs well.

How Performance Will Be Measured

We care about more than simply how many hours you work.

Performance may include:

- Calls made

- Leads contacted

- Meaningful conversations

- Speed-to-lead

- Follow-up completion

- Qualified leads generated

- Appointments scheduled

- Appointments held

- CRM accuracy

- Lead-to-client conversion

Our initial goal is approximately 4 qualified appointments per week, although expectations may be adjusted based on lead volume, list quality, and campaign type.

How to Apply

Please include all of the following:

1. Briefly describe your previous calling, sales, ISA, or lead-generation experience.

2. Tell us whether you have previously worked with a real estate agent, brokerage, investor, wholesaler, mortgage company, or property management company.

3. List the CRMs and dialers you have used.

4. Tell us your current internet speed and your backup internet plan.

5. Provide a link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be comfortable handling both inbound and outbound real estate leads.

6. Tell us your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time.

7. Tell us whether you currently work for any other clients and approximately how many hours per week.

IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words:

FOLLOW-UP MATTERS

This lets us know that you read the complete job posting and can follow instructions.

We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team, not simply completing short-term tasks.

The right person will eventually become an important part of our lead-management system—responding to new opportunities, nurturing existing leads, identifying motivated prospects, and making sure the right opportunities reach our broker and agents at the right time.

title: Freelance Web and Graphic Designer (Figma) | $100 to $150 a day
description:
We're Nera Marketing, a digital agency with offices in the UK and Dubai.



We're looking for a freelance designer who works in Figma. Most of the work is web pages. The rest is branding, marketing materials and social ads. We book work by the day or half day as projects come in.



You take a written brief and hand back finished work to a premium standard. You use AI tools to work faster. Clear communication matters to us as much as the design itself.



WHAT YOU'LL DESIGN

• Web pages in Figma, desktop and mobile, ready for our developers to build.

• Brand work: logos, identity and brand guidelines.

• Marketing materials: decks, brochures and one-pagers.

• Social and ad creative at 1080x1350 and 1080x1920.



WHAT YOU NEED

• Advanced Figma: auto layout, components, tidy named layers and prototypes.

• Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. InDesign is a plus.

• Confident use of AI tools in your design work.

• You work well from written briefs.

• Stable internet with a backup connection.

• A premium standard of finish on everything you hand over.



COMMUNICATION

• Clear written and spoken English.

• You reply to messages within 30 minutes while you're working.

• On booked days you're free for video calls from 1pm to 6pm Manila time, with your camera on.

• Now and then we need a call up to 8pm Manila time with our UK team. We book these ahead.

• You ask questions before you start, not after.

• You tell us early if anything will run late.



HOW WE WORK

• We book you by the day (8 hours) or half day (4 hours).

• We book at least 2 working days ahead.

• There's no fixed minimum. Work is booked as projects arrive.

• We add you to our team channels and our project management tool. All briefs, files and feedback go there.

• You work in our Figma files.

• All work and files belong to us and our clients once paid. Client work stays confidential. Using it in your portfolio needs our written OK.



PAY

• $100 to $150 a day, depending on experience.

• Paid every two weeks for the days you've worked.



HOW WE HIRE

1. You apply with your work.

2. We shortlist and have a 15 minute video call. You walk us through one of your own Figma projects.

3. Our top 3 get a paid test: a homepage hero plus one more section in desktop and mobile, and two social ads for the same brand (1080x1350 and 1080x1920). You have 48 hours. We pay for the test at your day rate.

4. A 15 minute call where you present your test in Figma.

5. We hire.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word KEYLINE. Then include:

• Your portfolio link.

• A Figma link with view access to one web project you designed.

• Two social ads you've made.

• Your day rate in USD.

• The AI tools you use, and what you use them for.

• Confirmation that you can take calls from 1pm to 6pm Manila time.



We review applications that start with KEYLINE and include a Figma link.

 what the subscriber sees in the first second.

Build them in Klaviyo — sliced into modules, each linking to its own destination, live text in header and footer, images compressed before upload, rendering checked on mobile.

Work from real product photography supplied by the client — composited into backgrounds you source or build. Not generic AI lifestyle imagery.

Adapt one design across a flow — a welcome series of 4
s shares a system, not four unrelated designs.

Build and maintain template libraries per brand so
 12 takes an hour, not a day.

Volume at steady state: roughly 30–60 designed
s a month across 6–10 brands, in batches with real deadlines.



Requirements



3+ years designing
 specifically. Not social graphics, not web design with
 on the side.

Figma, at a professional level — components, auto layout, variables. You will hand us files other people can work in.

Klaviyo hands-on. You have built templates, flow
s and campaigns inside it, and you know where its drag-and-drop builder breaks.

Typography and hierarchy. This is the part we actually screen on. Two typefaces, a clear scale, correct optical spacing, and an offer that is legible in half a second on a phone.

Photoshop or equivalent for retouching, masking and compositing product shots.

 rendering knowledge: what survives image blocking, why 1080px-wide designs beat 600px on modern phones, why a flat JPEG
 is a bad idea.

Written English good enough to read a brief closely and ask a precise question when something in it is wrong.

Stable connection, your own machine, and you reply inside a working day.



Nice to have



A brand you designed
 for that you can point at and say “that flow made the client money”.

Shopify or WooCommerce familiarity — dynamic product blocks, coupon codes.

Light motion: GIFs that load fast and still read when they do not animate.

You use AI tools as part of your process. Fine, and useful. But see below.



What we are not looking for



Designers whose portfolio is mostly AI-generated images, or Canva and Klaviyo stock templates with the client’s logo dropped in. We can generate images ourselves. What we cannot generate is someone with judgement about layout, spacing and hierarchy who knows what makes an
 get clicked.



How to apply



Short message, no cover letter. Include:



Three
s you designed — images or Figma links. For each, one sentence on what the brief asked for.

One Figma file we can open, so we can see how you build, not just what it looks like.

Which Klaviyo accounts you have worked in and what you did in them.

Your answer to this: you are given a welcome
 whose only offer is free shipping over €50. What goes in the hero, and why? Two or three sentences.

Start your message with the word SLICED so we know you read this.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test task — one
, real brief, real product photos, $30 for it whether or not we hire you.

title: Wholesale Sales & Marketing Coordinator
description:
Australian Chocolate & Confectionery Brand | 20 Hours Per Week | Potential Full-Time Opportunity

About Us

Charlotte Piper is a growing Australian-owned chocolate and confectionery manufacturer based in regional Victoria, Australia.

We are a small, passionate team producing handmade chocolates, fudge and confectionery, supplying retailers, gift stores, gourmet food stores and other businesses throughout Australia and New Zealand.

As our business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced, confident and proactive Wholesale Sales & Marketing Coordinator to join our team.

This is an important role within our business. We are looking for someone who can build genuine relationships with our customers, increase sales, identify new opportunities and take responsibility for the day-to-day management of our wholesale customer accounts.

This is predominantly a phone-based sales and customer relationship position, combined with sales administration and marketing support.

Your Main Responsibilities

Existing Wholesale Customers – Our First Priority

Our existing customers are extremely important to us, and maintaining these relationships will be your main priority.

You will be responsible for:

• Regularly contacting existing wholesale customers by phone.

• Building strong, friendly and professional relationships.

• Encouraging repeat orders and helping customers select suitable products.

• Following up with customers who haven't ordered recently.

• Identifying opportunities to increase orders and introduce additional products.

• Keeping customers informed about new products, seasonal ranges and promotions.

• Following up on seasonal ordering opportunities and deadlines.

• Responding to customer enquiries and assisting with orders.

• Ensuring customers feel valued and well looked after.

New & Inactive Customer Follow-Up

We have customers who have registered or expressed interest in Charlotte Piper but have not yet placed an order, along with previous customers who have not ordered for some time.

An important part of your role will be:

• Contacting registered customers who haven't yet ordered.

• Following up on enquiries and potential sales leads.

• Reconnecting with customers who haven't ordered for an extended period.

• Understanding why customers haven't ordered and identifying opportunities to assist them.

• Introducing customers to our product range and wholesale ordering process.

• Turning enquiries and leads into active wholesale customers.

Finding New Wholesale Customers

As the role develops, you will also help grow our wholesale customer base throughout Australia.

This will include:

• Researching suitable independent retailers and potential stockists.

• Contacting prospective customers by phone and
.

• Introducing Charlotte Piper and our products.

• Identifying opportunities with gift stores, gourmet food stores, specialty retailers and other suitable businesses.

• Following up with prospective customers and helping convert them into stockists.

• Maintaining accurate records of leads and follow-up activities.

Major retail chains, large corporate accounts and key commercial negotiations will remain the responsibility of the business owner.

Your focus will primarily be on independent retailers, existing wholesale accounts and developing new stockist relationships.

Sales Administration & Order Management

We also need someone who is happy to assist with the administrative side of our sales operations.

Responsibilities will include:

• Entering and processing wholesale orders.

• Updating customer information and sales records.

• Assisting with Ordermentum, Faire and other wholesale platforms.

• Following up on outstanding enquiries and orders.

• Maintaining accurate customer notes and follow-up records.

• Assisting with invoicing and sales-related administration.

• Supporting other administrative tasks as required.

• Helping improve our customer management and sales processes.

Experience with Xero would be a significant advantage.

Marketing & Sales Development

We want someone who can think beyond simply making calls and entering orders.

You will also assist with:

• Suggesting promotions and opportunities to increase sales.

• Helping promote new products and seasonal collections.

• Identifying trends and opportunities from customer feedback.

• Assisting with customer
 campaigns and newsletters.

• Working with our team to develop sales and marketing ideas.

• Suggesting improvements to how we communicate with customers.

We welcome fresh ideas and people who can think outside the square.

Excellent Spoken English Is Essential

This is one of the most important requirements for this position.

You will be speaking directly with Australian retailers and business owners, representing Charlotte Piper over the phone.

You must have:

• Exceptional spoken and written English.

• Clear, fluent and natural pronunciation.

• A confident, friendly and professional telephone manner.

• Excellent listening and conversational skills.

• A strong understanding of Australian communication styles, expressions and terminology.

• The ability to think quickly and respond naturally to questions.

• Confidence handling customer conversations without relying entirely on scripts.

We want our customers to feel as though they are speaking directly with someone from our Charlotte Piper office in Kerang, Victoria.

Previous experience working with Australian businesses or Australian customers would be a major advantage.

Experience & Skills

We would particularly value experience in:

• Outbound sales and customer relationship management.

• Australian wholesale or retail sales.

• Business-to-business (B2B) sales.

• Account management and customer retention.

• Lead generation and new customer acquisition.

• Ordermentum and Faire.

• Xero.

• CRM systems and customer databases.

• Sales administration and data entry.

• Food, gourmet products, confectionery or chocolate.

A strong understanding of food products, particularly chocolate and confectionery, would be highly regarded.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone who is:

• Confident, outgoing and not afraid to pick up the phone.

• Friendly, personable and professional.

• Proactive and motivated.

• Quick-thinking and able to think on their feet.

• Comfortable building genuine customer relationships.

• Organised and accurate.

• Reliable and accountable.

• Able to work independently.

• Comfortable asking questions and seeking clarification.

• Willing to assist with administration and order processing.

• Able to identify opportunities and take initiative.

• A team player who genuinely wants to help grow our business.

We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions.

If a customer hasn't ordered for several months, we want you to notice and follow up.

If a new customer has registered but hasn't ordered, we want you to make contact.

If you identify a potential new stockist, we want you to investigate the opportunity.

And if you have an idea that could help increase sales or improve customer relationships, we want to hear it.

Hours & Opportunity

This position will initially be approximately 20 hours per week, working during agreed Victorian, Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

As the role is predominantly telephone-based, availability during Australian business hours is essential.

There is potential for the role to develop into a full-time position as the business grows.

We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, enjoys being part of a team and is excited about helping a growing Australian chocolate brand succeed.

If you are confident on the phone, enjoy building relationships, have excellent English communication skills and genuinely love sales, we would love to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist | Meta Ads, DTC, E-commerce, Dropshipping
description:
Creative Strategist | Meta Ads, DTC, E-commerce

Full-time | Remote | Philippines daytime hours

$1,800-$2,500/month depending on experience



ABOUT US

We’re an e-commerce team running our own online stores and regularly launching and testing products across different niches. Our work combines customer research, direct-response advertising, and AI-assisted creative production to find products and messages that resonate with buyers.



You’ll work directly with the founder and our existing team of video editors. We’re building a long-term team where people contribute ideas, see them brought to life, and learn from real advertising results.



Alongside our own stores, we’ve recently expanded into creative services for clients and brought on our first account. We’re looking for someone who wants to become a key part of the business, help shape our creative approach, and grow into broader responsibilities as we expand.



ROLE OVERVIEW

You’ll lead creative strategy for our own e-commerce stores and client accounts, d
 what we test and why. You’ll dig into customer reviews, competitor ads, product research, and Meta ad performance to uncover promising audiences, angles, and hooks. Then you’ll turn those insights into scripts and clear briefs for video and static ads, giving our AI video editors the direction they need to bring your ideas to life.



You’ll work with the founder and editors to take concepts through production, review, and testing, using performance results to shape the next round.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research products, competitors, customer pain points, desires, and objections.

- Develop audiences, angles, hooks, and messaging for our own products and client accounts, with clear reasoning behind what to test and why.

- Write direct-response scripts and briefs for video and static ads, including alternative hooks, headlines, and ad copy.

- Give our AI video editors clear visual direction, including key shots, scene flow, references, and what needs to be generated.

- Help structure creative tests and explain what each concept is intended to test.

- Work closely with the founder and editors to prioritize concepts, coordinate production, and provide actionable feedback on finished creatives.

- Analyze creative performance and use the findings to develop new concepts and variations.

- Keep briefs, creative status, and testing results organized, maintaining a steady flow of ideas through production and testing.

- Spot new formats and trends, and adapt them to each product.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Previous creative strategy and copywriting experience with e-commerce/dropshipping brands.

- Real-world ads you briefed or scripted, with results you can show or talk through.

- Strong understanding of direct-response advertising, and customer psychology.

- Familiarity with Meta ads, current online trends, and different advertising formats.

- Strong written English, storytelling, and communication skills.

- Ability to turn research into clear creative direction and work effectively with editors.

- Comfortable interpreting metrics such as CTR, CPA, and ROAS.

- Previous experience with AI creative is a plus.



WORK ETHIC & OWNERSHIP

This is especially important to us. We want someone who takes ownership, treats our stores and client accounts like their own, and cares about the actual results. That means:

- You bring a plan for what to test next without waiting to be asked.

- When an ad underperforms, you investigate why and propose what to improve.

- You keep fresh concepts moving into production before the team runs out of ideas.

- You meet deadlines and communicate early when something needs attention.

- You measure your contribution by business results, not just completed tasks.



WHAT WE OFFER

- A long-term, full-time, remote role with Philippines daytime working hours.

- $1,800-$2,500 per month with a clear path to salary increases as you deliver and as we grow.

- Opportunities to take on broader leadership responsibilities as our stores, client accounts, and creative team grow.

- Performance bonuses available.

- Direct collaboration with the founder and an existing team of video editors.

- See your ideas brought to life and tested quickly.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your subject line with “GROW WITH US” so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please number your answers and include:

1. Your resume.

2. At least three examples of creatives you develop, with the original briefs and finished ads.

3. Performance results tied to those examples, including data like date range, ad spend, and ROAS or CPA (links, screenshots, or a short description of the numbers)

4. Your years of creative strategy experience in e-commerce/DTC.

5. The brands and products you’ve worked with.

6. Your current commitments and availability.

### Ready to #BEcomeMAXX?

Then we want to hear from you!



**Apply now and help us build the next generation of talent at IronMaxx.**

title: Kit Logistics Coordinator
description:
KIT LOGISTICS COORDINATOR (REMOTE, FREELANCE, PAID PER EVENT)



At ChefPassport (
), we run live virtual cooking events for corporate teams around the world, and we ship ingredient kits to participants. You will make sure every participant receives the right ingredients on time. As you grow with us, you will also build our network of reliable delivery partners in the US, Canada and Europe.



WHAT YOU WILL DO ON EVERY EVENT



● Build and maintain the participant tracker for each event: addresses, countries, dietary answers, order numbers, delivery status.

● Chase clients and participants until every address and dietary form is complete.

● Place ingredient orders with our delivery partners or with grocery delivery services in each country, applying per-person substitutions for allergies and diets.

● Track every shipment daily, contact participants who have not confirmed receipt, arrange replacements, and escalate anything unresolved 72 hours before the event.

● After the event, reconcile supplier invoices, log the cost per kit and per country, and write a short lessons note.



PARTNER ONBOARDING (PAID SEPARATELY, ONLY WHEN WE ASK FOR IT)



Some countries and larger orders need a reliable local partner. When we need one, we give you a short brief and you will:



● Find and contact the right B2B partner, and build the relationship. Priority regions: the US, Canada, Western Europe, the UK and Switzerland. Occasionally other countries.

● Collect their terms and complete our partner dossier: coverage, minimum and maximum order size, lead time, cost per kit, allergen labelling, delivery to third-party addresses, invoicing terms, and a named contact.

● Run a real test order and check that it arrives correctly.

● Identify one backup option for the same region.

● Record everything in our shared partner tracker.

● After approval, manage the relationship day to day: reorders, issues, and updates.



You use a ChefPassport
 address that we provide and introduce yourself as working on behalf of ChefPassport. You gather terms. ChefPassport negotiates, signs and agrees prices. All partner contacts and records belong to ChefPassport.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



● 2 years running order processing, fulfilment or purchasing for an e-commerce store, a logistics company or an events business.

● Proof that you work by the number: you keep trackers that are complete, you confirm before you assume, you flag problems before they become emergencies.

● Fluent written English, with a professional tone for B2B
s and calls. A second language (Spanish, French, German or Dutch) is a plus.

● Comfortable ordering on Instacart, Ocado, Albert Heijn, Migros and similar services, or able to learn a new one in an hour.

● Google Sheets at a working level: filters, lookups, conditional formatting.

● Available for daily check-ins in weeks when an event is being delivered, including some overlap with US Eastern working hours.

● Reliable internet and a quiet place to make the occasional call to a supplier or partner.



HOW WE PAY



Everything is paid per event or per outcome. There is no fixed monthly pay.



Per event:

● Base fee: $75 (up to 30 kits, one country)

● Above 30 kits: $2 per kit

● Each additional country in the same event: $15

● Bonus: $25 if 100% of kits are confirmed 48 hours before the event

● Voucher events (no shipping): flat $30 for the tracker and follow-up



Per partner (only when we send you a brief and accept the result):

● Shortlist fee: $25 for a shortlist of 3 qualified candidates, even if none is chosen

● Onboarding fee: $100 for a partner covering one country, plus $50 for each additional country covered, up to $250 per partner



Trial:

● Paid trial task: $20 flat, paid whether or not you are selected. If it goes well, you take a first paid event.



Payment:

● Paid in USD within 7 days of your invoice, via Revolut if you have an account, otherwise by international bank transfer.

● We offer work one by one, and you can decline any.



VOLUME



Seasonal. Busiest from October to December, with a smaller wave from April to June, and quiet otherwise. We expect about 15 to 20 events per year, plus occasional partner briefs. This is a part-time freelance role and does not replace a full-time income.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You own his calendar, inbox and priorities. Every meeting he walks into is prepped. Every
 that needs him is drafted in his voice, ready to approve. Everything else is handled or redirected. His week goes to growth, not admin.



2. The operating rhythm

You run the weekly leadership meeting, the Monday store scorecard and the monthly business review. You set the agenda, collect the numbers, take the minutes and send the actions within 24 hours.



3. Follow-through

Every commitment made by the CEO or the leadership team is tracked to done. You chase leaders, external advisers, store managers, suppliers, landlords and advisers on the CEO's behalf, and you flag anything slipping before it becomes a problem.



4. Projects that move the business

You run a couple of cross-functional projects at a time, such as new store opening trackers, franchise launch readiness, recruitment pipelines and supplier changes. You keep owners, dates and status visible, and you report progress weekly.

- CEO focusses on growth, and not admin



YOU'RE RIGHT FOR THIS IF YOU
