title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
About us



We're a plaintiff personal injury firm. We handle catastrophic injury, trucking and commercial vehicle crashes, wrongful death, premises liability and medical malpractice. We have a few hundred open files and we're still growing. A former district judge and a former prosecutor run the firm, so we care a lot about honesty in how we report time, deadlines and mistakes.



What the job is



You take the file once suit is filed and carry it through trial prep. You know where every case stands and what's due next. Day to day, that means:



Pleadings: petitions, amended petitions and service

Discovery: interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, discovery responses, and defendants' written discovery questionnaires

Records and damages: records requests, business records affidavits, Section 18.001 affidavits, and watching for counter-affidavits

Experts: lining up experts, collecting reports and filing designations

Depositions: notices, subpoenas and exhibits, plus coordination with opposing counsel, court reporters and clients

Deadlines: calendaring the docket control order and tracking every deadline on every file

Mediation and trial prep: mediation packets, exhibit and witness lists, and pretrial filings



You'll work every day with the attorney, the case manager and the legal assistant on your team. There's no training period.



What we're looking for

At least one year of plaintiff personal injury litigation on filed cases

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure

Daily use of case management software across a heavy caseload

The habit of telling the attorney bad news early



We don't hire people who pad their hours. This has to be your only job.



Working remote

A private workspace and internet reliable enough for depositions and client calls, with backup internet and backup power

Online during Central Time business hours, on camera for team meetings, and responsive on chat

Time logged by task as you go

Firm files stay in firm systems

Hours and pay



The job is 40 hours a week, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time. In Manila, that's 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. from mid-March to early November, and 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. the rest of the year.



Those who do well will receive intermittent bonuses. That’s right,  bonuses are available, for those who perform above average and add value.



. Include your full ask in your application: rate, PTO, holidays, allowances and payment method.



Screening questions



Answer each one in a few sentences, in your own words. We care more about how you think than about polished writing.



A docket control order arrives with a trial setting eight months out. What goes on the calendar first, and how do you work backward from trial?

A defendant was served 24 days ago and there's no answer on file. What do you check, and what do you tell the attorney?

The defense serves a counter-affidavit to your client's Section 18.001 affidavit. What do you do that day, and what does it change about the case?

Expert designations are due Friday. The expert hasn't sent a CV or report, and the last provider's records haven't come in. What do you do, and in what order?

It's Monday. You have discovery responses due today, a deposition tomorrow with exhibits that aren't final, an upset client on the phone, and an attorney who wants an amended petition by Wednesday. How do you order that list, and why?

You realize a deadline on one of your files passed last week. What do you do in the next hour?



In your application, also confirm your rate and whether you work for anyone else now.

Job Title: Lead Manager / Appointment Specialist (Football Placement & Athlete Support)



Type: Full-time | Remote

About the Role

FutXPerform (FXP) is an international sports placement and career development platform dedicated to helping promising football players take the next step toward joining our elite development and pathway programmes.



We are looking for a organized, persuasive, and proactive Lead Manager / Appointment Specialist to manage lead conversations from first contact through to a qualified, attended consultation with our sales team.



This role is ideal for someone who excels at building trust with young athletes and parents, asking thoughtful qualifying questions, staying highly organized, and following through consistently.



What You’ll Do

* Outreach & Lead Engagement: Engage potential players through approved outreach channels and respond promptly to incoming enquiries.

* Qualification & Discovery: Learn each player’s football background, goals, and current circumstances to assess fit for an FXP programme.

* Clear Expectations: Explain our programmes and next steps clearly and accurately (without making false promises regarding contracts, trials, or guaranteed placements).

* Persistent Follow-Up: Nurture interested players, answer preliminary questions, and ensure they are well-prepared for their scheduled consultation.

* Appointment Setting & Attendance: Coordinate bookings and send timely reminders to maximize show-up rates. Involve parents or guardians in the conversation whenever appropriate.

* CRM Management: Maintain detailed lead records, log call outcomes, and brief the sales team with key player context prior to booked calls.

* Process Improvement: Share recurring questions, common player objections, and lead trends with the core team to refine messaging and conversion rates.



What We’re Looking For

* Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with a warm, empathetic, and confident tone.

* Relevant Experience: Background in lead qualification, recruitment outreach, appointment setting, or sales support.

* High Standards: Solid judgment on who qualifies as a high-fit lead for our sales team.

* Systems & Targets: Comfortable managing leads in a CRM and consistently hitting performance metrics.

* Domain Interest: A background, interest, or passion for football (soccer) is a huge advantage.



Compensation & Performance Incentive Structure

We offer a stable monthly base salary paired with generous performance-based incentives for qualified scheduled calls and closed enrollments.



* Base Salary: PHP 15,000 / month

*Per Qualified Attended Call: PHP 200 / call

* Per Closed Sale/Enrollment: PHP 2,500 / closed client

* Total Earning Potential: PHP 15,000 – PHP 29,000+ per month



Scenario Breakdown (Example Target Month):

Assuming 20 qualified calls attend their scheduled call with a 20% close rate (4 closed sales):



* Base Salary: PHP 15,000

* 20 Attended Calls: PHP 4,000 (20 x PHP 200)

* 4 Closed Sales: PHP 10,000 (4 x PHP 2,500)

* Total Monthly Payout: PHP 29,000 or More depends on your closing rate

description:
CRO Strategist, Shopify A/B Testing, Part-time



About us

Beyond the Fold is a CRO agency for Shopify brands in the US and UK. We work a bit differently from most agencies. Before we test anything, we study the best brands in the world, Reddit, competitors, heatmaps, post-purchase surveys and reviews. Our AI system does a lot of the research on top brands. Your job is to turn that research into a plan.



The role

You build the monthly A/B testing roadmap for each of our clients. It’s a clear plan of what we’re testing over the next 30 days, across every key area of the store: homepage, product page, cart and checkout.



What you’ll do



Research and analyze data from Shopify, Intelligems, heatmaps and session recordings

Read reviews, Reddit threads and competitor sites

Set up and read post-purchase surveys

Come up with test ideas and explain the reasoning behind each one

Write clear briefs for our designers: what the test is, where it goes on the page, what changes, the references to follow and the copy to use

Review the Figma designs against the brief and get them right before they go to the developer

Read test results in Intelligems and d
 what wins, what loses and what launches next

Talk to clients on Slack and walk them through the monthly plan

Anything else that comes up



What you need



Real CRO experience with Shopify brands, with tests you’ve run and what happened

Strong Shopify knowledge

Experience with Intelligems. Hotjar, Clarity, GA4 or KnoCommerce is a plus.

Comfortable in Figma, and able to write a design brief a designer can follow without asking questions

Clear written English. Our clients are US and UK founders.



Hours and pay



Around 2 to 4 hours of focused work a day, about 20 hours a week

Part-time, but open to full-time for the right person

Normal daytime hours. I’m based in Bali, which is on the same time zone as the Philippines.

You need to check Slack throughout the day, even when you’re not actively working, and reply to clients and the team. Because our clients are in the US and UK, this sometimes runs into the evening, but rarely past 7 to 9pm.

Pay depends on experience. Tell us your expected monthly rate for part-time and for full-time.



How to apply

To apply, send us one test idea for each of these four areas of 
:



Homepage

Product page

Cart

Checkout



For each one, tell us the first thing you’d test and why: what you noticed, what you think will happen, and which number it should move. A short paragraph each is enough. An annotated screenshot or quick sketch is welcome but not required.



IM8 isn’t one of our clients. It’s a popular, fast-growing brand we picked for this exercise.



Please also include:



Your expected rate

One or two tests you’ve run before and their results



No AI applications - apply in your own voice. AI generated applications will be ignored



Put “IM8” at the start of your subject line so we know you read this far. Applications without all four ideas won’t be reviewed.

Business Development Researcher — Oakway



Reports to: Head of Business Development

About Oakway



Oakway helps businesses plan, design and deliver complete commercial, warehouse and industrial fit-out projects. We specifically target small and medium-sized, fast-growing businesses that value end-to-end support to reduce risk and make life easier during a critical stage of their growth.



The Role



We're looking for a curious, organised and proactive BD researcher to research potential customers, gather accurate company information and populate a standardised information table template within HubSpot. There may also be an opportunity to develop into writing personalised introductory
s in the future.



You will do the groundwork at the start of our sales process: researching companies online, finding the right decision-makers and their contact details, and recording accurate, relevant company information within HubSpot to support the Business Development team.



Key Responsibilities



- Research opportunities: Identify target companies, decision-makers and signs of potential projects, including expansion, relocation, investment and property activity.



- Build quality data: Maintain accurate, relevant prospect records, verify contact details, remove duplicates and record information sources. Populate the standardised company information table template within HubSpot, ensuring all required fields are completed accurately and consistently.



- Find the right contacts: Research online and make fact-finding calls to company reception teams to identify decision-makers and obtain their contact details. These are research calls only, not sales calls.



- Use online research tools: Research companies using a combination of ChatGPT, CoStar, Google Maps, Creditsafe, LinkedIn, 
, Lusha, company websites and other relevant online sources. Information gathered should be checked for accuracy and entered into the standardised company information table template within HubSpot.



- Potential future responsibility —
 drafting: As knowledge and experience develop, there may be an opportunity to draft personalised introductory
s using the information gathered during research. This is not a requirement of the initial role.



What Success Looks Like



Accurate prospect data, clearly displayed company information in the standardised information table within HubSpot, and a consistent flow of well-researched company records, complete with relevant decision-maker details, that enable the BD Executive to identify and progress potential opportunities.



The BD function's target for 2027 is 156 Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs). To support this, your day-to-day target is to research 30 companies per day, complete the standard information table and move each company's status from 'New' to 'Researched' in the 'Kill the Red' pipeline.



Success in this role will be measured primarily by the accuracy, completeness and volume of research completed, rather than sales or lead conversion activity.



What We're Looking For



- Strong research skills and attention to detail.

- Clear, confident English.

- Comfortable on the phone, including calling company reception teams to find the right contact.

- Curiosity about businesses and their growth plans.

- Confidence using CRM systems and online research tools such as LinkedIn, 
, ChatGPT and Lusha.

- Willingness to learn and handle a busy research workload.



Development



This is a growing team. As you build experience and knowledge, there is the opportunity to develop within the role, including potentially taking on personalised introductory
 drafting, and progress as Oakway grows.

title: Creative Marketing and Content Manager
description:
Important: to be considered, you must include a link to your portfolio.

Please include a link to your portfolio in your application.

Applications without a portfolio or work sample will not be reviewed.



Kijana Kwanza (Young People First) is a UK and Tanzania registered youth charity supporting children and young people in Tanzania. 

We’re looking for a Creative Marketing and Content Manager to develop our visual identity and produce engaging content that supports our fundraising. Your work will show international donors and supporters both the need for our work and the impact of our programmes. Approximately 80% of the role focuses on producing donor-facing communications and fundraising media, with the remaining 20% supporting local communications, organisational activities and service promotion.



What you’ll be doing



Design & Visual Content Production

• Design high-quality printed and digital materials including brochures, annual reports, newsletters, presentations, posters, banners, educational resources, certificates and promotional materials.

• Produce engaging graphics and multimedia content for websites, social media, fundraising campaigns, donor communications and digital platforms.

• Develop visual assets including infographics, icons, illustrations, branded templates and presentation materials.

• Maintain and develop Kijana Kwanza’s visual identity and ensure consistent application of brand guidelines.



Fundraising & Donor Communications

• Create compelling donor-facing materials that communicate community need, programme impact and organisational achievements.

• Support the preparation of funding proposals, donor reports and fundraising campaigns through high-quality visual design.

• Work with programme managers to translate technical reports, monitoring data and project information into accessible visual content.

Photography, Video & Media Library

• Edit and organise photographs, maintaining a comprehensive image and media library.

• Produce and edit short videos (normally under three minutes) for fundraising, donor engagement and social media.



Storytelling & Social Media

• Write short social media posts and captions to accompany photographs, videos and campaigns.

Events & Print Production

• Design materials for events, graduations, conferences, training sessions and community activities.

• Prepare artwork for professional printing and digital publication.

• Liaise with printers, merchandise suppliers and other creative providers.



Youth Coaching & Mentoring

• Coach, mentor and provide practical training to young people, interns, volunteers and apprentices in graphic design, photography, videography, social media content creation and the effective use of creative software, supporting Kijana Kwanza’s commitment to developing future creative professionals.



Project Management & Professional Development

• Manage multiple design and media projects simultaneously.

• Keep up to date with developments in graphic design, photography and multimedia communications.

• Provide creative advice and support to colleagues.

• Undertake any other duties consistent with the responsibilities of the role.



What we’re looking for

• A degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• At least 5 years’ experience in graphic design across print and digital

• Excellent skills in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop)

• Ability to edit high-quality video

• Strong typography, layout and visual storytelling skills

• Excellent written English, including short-form social media writing

• Experience coaching, training or mentoring others in creative or digital skills



Nice to have

• Experience with animation or motion graphics

• Experience in the charity or international development sector

• Knowledge of social media marketing



What we offer

• A permanent, full-time remote role

• The chance to use your creativity for work that changes young people’s lives



How to apply

 your application to 
 with the subject line “Creative Manager – [your full name]”. Include:

1. Your CV

2. A link to your portfolio, or at least one example of your work

3. A line on how you learned your skills: a degree, a course, or self-taught. All are welcome.



How our hiring works

1. Application review: we look at your CV and portfolio.

2. Practical test: shortlisted applicants get a short brief with real material from our team: a 30-second video and a poster.

3. Interview: a final video call with our Country Director.



Remember: applications without a portfolio or work sample will not be reviewed.

title: AI Video Editor for a US DTC Brand Spending $250K/Month on Meta | $1,500/mo + Up to $3,050 Bonus per Winning Ad
description:
If you make AI ads that actually sell, read this.



We are a US DTC brand with one hero product, selling in the US, UK, Canada and Australia. We spend more than $250,000 a month on Meta ads, and our winners are AI made: Pixar style stories, AI UGC, AI song ads and realistic AI dramas. On Meta, the creative d
 everything. That is why the editor who makes it matters most to us.



You will not get footage to cut. You get a script and a reference ad, and you build the whole ad with AI: characters, scenes, voices, music and edit. You see the real Meta results of every ad you make, and you get paid when it wins.



WHY THIS SEAT

• Real budget behind your ads: more than $250,000 a month on Meta

• A bonus on every winning ad, up to $3,050 per ad, with no limit on the number of ads

• $1,500 a month fixed from day 1, raised to $1,800 after 3 months, in writing

• All AI tools and credits paid by us, on our own AI platform

• One brand, clear briefs, fast feedback, and a long term seat



Please read the whole post. Messages that do not follow the steps at the bottom are not reviewed.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Turn our briefs into finished 9:16 video ads. Most of them are short (30 to 90 seconds): Pixar style stories, AI UGC, an AI founder talking to camera, scam warning ads, warehouse and promo ads. Every brief comes with the script or a reference ad, the characters and scene by scene notes.

• Generate every image and every scene yourself with AI. Keep the same characters and the same product from one shot to the next, with believable lip sync and voices.

• Edit the ad: pacing, captions, music and sound. Strong first 3 seconds, no dead air.

• Make 3 versions of each new ad: 2 versions with a new hook (newscript and new visuals for the opening), and 1 version with a Black woman as the main character.

• Deliver every day in our shared folder and turn feedback around fast.



THE FORMATS (you must already have made them)

• AI UGC: a realistic woman talking to camera, using or wearing the product

• Realistic AI drama: several characters, dialogue, a twist and a payoff

• Pixar style 3D animation

• AI song ads: a full song made with Suno, characters singing in sync



YOUR TOOLS (you must already master them)

• Images: Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2

• Animation: Kling and Seedance

• Voices: ElevenLabs

• Music: Suno

• Claude Code (we use it every day in our process)

• Editing: CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro



YOUR SETUP

• A powerful computer: 16 GB of RAM minimum (32 GB preferred), able to edit 4K timelines smoothly

• Fast and stable internet (50 Mbps or more) and backup power



THE CADENCE

You work in batches. A batch = 1 new ad + 3 versions of it. So 1 batch = 4 finished ads.

Target: 2 batches a day, so 8 finished ads a day.

Briefs are sent in advance, so you always know what is next.



THE PAY

• $1,500 a month, fixed, from day 1. Monday to Friday, 8 hours a day.

• Raised to $1,800 a month after 3 months if the targets are met. We put it in writing in your contract.

• Plus a bonus every time one of your ads reaches a spend milestone while hitting our target ROAS:

  $10,000 spent: $150

  $40,000 spent: $250

  $80,000 spent: $400

  $160,000 spent: $750

  $300,000 spent: $1,500

  Your winning ads keep paying you as they scale. No limit on the number of ads.

• Once you are hired, all AI credits and subscriptions are paid by us.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• AI ads you made yourself, in at least 2 of the 4 formats above

• Strong written English: all briefs and feedback are in English

• Full time and exclusive: no other job and no other client. Ready to start on Monday, November 2.

• Reliable and on time, and you take direct feedback well ("recut the first 3 seconds" is normal here)



HOW WE HIRE

1. Short free test: you follow a brief to make one Pixar style ad (about 2 hours), for a fictional brand, on our own AI platform (all generation costs are on us).

2. One paid trial week at the real pace

3. Long term contract



HOW TO APPLY

Send us a message here on OnlineJobs. The first word of your message must be LIGHTHOUSE.

title: AI Video Editor | AI UGC for E-commerce brands
description:
**MUST HAVE STRONG VIDEO EDITING EXPERIENCE AND A DEEP UNDERSTANDING OF INSTAGRAM CONTENT.**



## Company Description



We are a rapidly growing e-commerce company operating multiple brands across platforms including Meta Ads, Google Ads, Instagram, TikTok and more.



We are heavily investing in AI-generated creative and are looking for someone who understands how to create AI video content that does **not feel obviously AI-generated**.



## Role Description



We are seeking a remote, contract **AI Video Editor** who specialises in creating realistic, authentic and natural-looking **AI UGC and direct-response video advertisements**.



This is not simply a traditional video editing position.



You will be responsible for combining **AI video generation, UGC-style creative and professional video editing** to produce advertisements that feel native to platforms such as Instagram,
 and 
.



The goal is simple:



**Create AI-generated videos that feel like genuine content filmed by a real person on their phone.**



You should understand how to avoid the overly polished, unnatural or artificial look commonly associated with AI-generated content.



Working from scripts, briefs, references and existing creative concepts, you will generate and edit content with a strong focus on:



- Realistic AI-generated people, environments and product interactions

- Natural AI UGC that feels candid rather than staged

- Authentic movement, expressions and body language

- Realistic product placement and product usage

- Natural lighting, camera movement and smartphone-style footage

- Strong hooks and attention-grabbing opening scenes

- Native Instagram and TikTok pacing

- Authentic cuts, pauses, imperfections and transitions

- Direct-response storytelling

- Maintaining viewer retention throughout the video

- Creating advertisements designed to generate conversions, not simply look good



You will also be expected to understand current trends across **Instagram Reels, TikTok and Meta advertising**, including the visual styles and editing techniques that make content feel organic to these platforms.



## Qualifications



- At least 1 year of professional video editing experience, preferably within e-commerce or social media advertising

- **Demonstrated experience creating AI-generated video content**

- Experience creating realistic **AI UGC-style videos**

- Strong understanding of what makes AI-generated footage look authentic versus obviously artificial

- Strong understanding of Instagram, Instagram Reels and short-form social content

- Experience editing content for
, Instagram and TikTok

- Experience creating direct-response advertisements designed to generate sales

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling

- Ability to match reference videos and recreate specific creative styles

- Strong proficiency with professional video editing software

- Experience working with modern AI video generation tools and workflows

- Ability to identify and correct unnatural AI movements, expressions, product interactions or visual inconsistencies

- Strong attention to detail

- Proficient English communication skills of at least C1 level

- Availability to work according to Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT)



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who understands that **good AI UGC should not feel like AI UGC**.



The ideal candidate has a strong eye for the small details that make content believable: camera shake, lighting, framing, pacing, facial expressions, natural pauses, imperfect movement and realistic interactions with products.



You should regularly consume content on Instagram and TikTok and have a strong understanding of what currently feels authentic on these platforms.



We value:



- Adaptability

- Fast communication

- Strong creative judgement

- Attention to detail

- Willingness to experiment with new AI tools

- Eagerness to learn

- Ability to take feedback and iterate quickly

- Ambition to grow into a larger creative role within the company



This is a **REMOTE position**.

- AI video generation

- AI UGC

- Video editing

- Instagram/TikTok content

- E-commerce advertising

- Direct-response creative



**Please include examples of AI-generated videos you have created or edited. Applications without relevant video examples may not be considered.**

title: Social Media Video Editor & Marketing Assistant

About WebLift Digital

WebLift Digital is a growing digital marketing agency dedicated to helping businesses build a strong, authentic, and results-driven online presence.



We combine creativity, innovation, and practical marketing strategies to help brands connect with their audiences, attract new customers, and achieve sustainable growth.

 Reels, or TikTok.

-Familiarity with Instagram and
 content formats and best practices.

-Experience creating social media graphics in Canva.

-Familiarity with Asana, Trello, or other project management tools.

-Experience preparing social media analytics reports.

-Basic knowledge of social media advertising and paid content.

-Experience working with multiple brands or a digital marketing agency.

-Understanding of content marketing, branding, and social media growth strategies.

-The Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who is:

-Creative: You bring fresh ideas and understand what makes content engaging.

-Trend-aware: You actively follow social media trends and know how to adapt them to different brands.

Requirements

3 to 5 years of hands-on PPC experience, with meaningful time spent inside Amazon Ads consoles

Fluent understanding of core marketplace metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and impression share, and what movements in each actually mean

High attention to detail and accuracy when making changes in live client accounts

Fluent written English and reliable, responsive async communication

Ability to prioritise multiple deadlines

Experience with Walmart Connect or Chewy Ads, or proven ability to master new ad platforms quickly

Experience with Scale Insights or similar PPC automation and analytics tools

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts in parallel

Exposure to DSP campaigns

Experience with bulk operations files and large-scale campaign restructures

Familiarity with ClickUp



Success Measures

Accuracy in live account changes such as wrong bids, budgets, or targeting

Pacing: daily budget checks completed on schedule with issues flagged same day

Reporting: weekly snapshots delivered on time and requiring minimal rework

Independence: routine optimisation tasks executed to brief without repeated correction.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts independently after onboarding 



What We Offer

Fully remote, full-time independent contractor engagement

Semi-flexible work hours

Paid Time off

 video ads, 6–15 seconds each, in 9:16 and 1:1

 on-model before/after image pairs (clear with eyes visible / tinted with eyes hidden)

 static ads in 1:1 and 4:5

2 rounds of revisions

Final files plus editable source files where possible

Your portfolio, with at least one AI-assisted product ad

title: home health administrative asistant
description:
The Home Health Administrative Assistant provides administrative and operational support to ensure the efficient daily functioning of the home health agency. This position assists with patient intake, referral processing, medical record management, scheduling, billing preparation, payroll documentation, and communication with patients, physicians, caregivers, and clinical staff.



The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and familiar with home health operations, Medicare documentation requirements, and electronic medical record (EMR) systems.









Essential Duties and Responsibilities



1. Patient Intake and Referral Coordination



Receive, process, and track incoming patient referrals from hospitals, physicians, rehabilitation facilities, and other referral sources.



Collect and verify required patient demographic information, insurance details, physician information, and referral documentation.



Assist with obtaining hospital discharge summaries, medication lists, orders, and other supporting records.



Coordinate with the clinical team to facilitate timely patient admissions.



Maintain accurate referral and admission tracking logs.



Communicate with patients and caregivers regarding scheduling and administrative requirements.



2. Medical Records and Documentation



Maintain complete, accurate, and organized electronic and paper patient records, as applicable.



Monitor documentation for missing signatures, incomplete forms, outstanding physician orders, and other administrative deficiencies.



Follow up with nurses, therapists, physicians, and other authorized personnel regarding outstanding documentation.



Track required admission, recertification, reassessment, discharge, and other clinical documentation deadlines.



Assist with organizing documentation for internal audits, payer reviews, and accreditation surveys.



Protect patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and agency privacy policies.



3. Scheduling and Staff Coordination



Assist with scheduling skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, and other authorized home health visits.



Communicate scheduling changes and patient care coordination needs to the appropriate clinical personnel.



Track missed visits, rescheduled visits, and outstanding visit documentation.



Maintain staff contact lists, schedules, and administrative records.



Escalate urgent scheduling issues and patient-related concerns to the appropriate clinical supervisor.



4. Billing and Payroll Support



Review visit documentation for administrative completeness before submitting records for billing review.



Identify missing or incomplete visit notes and communicate correction requirements to the responsible clinician.



Maintain a tracking log of visits pending documentation, billing submission, or correction.



Assist with preparing completed visit records for billing personnel or the designated billing vendor.



Verify submitted visit records against approved staff schedules and visit logs for payroll processing.



Identify discrepancies in visit dates, visit durations, documentation, or approved pay records and report them to management.



Meet established billing and payroll deadlines.



Maintain confidentiality of employee compensation and payroll information.



5. Physician Orders and Follow-Up



Track outstanding physician orders, certifications, recertifications, and required signatures.



Follow up with physician offices regarding pending documentation.



Maintain a log of orders sent, received, and awaiting completion.



Route clinical questions, changes in patient condition, and medical concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician.



Do not independently provide clinical advice, alter medical orders, or make clinical decisions.



6. Compliance and Quality Assurance Support



Assist with maintaining administrative records required for Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and applicable state requirements.



Support preparation for internal audits, accreditation reviews, and regulatory surveys.



Monitor administrative checklists for incomplete records and overdue documentation.



Follow agency policies for record retention, privacy, security, and document handling.



Report suspected compliance issues, documentation irregularities, or privacy incidents to the Administrator.



Complete assigned compliance training and maintain required confidentiality standards.



7. Communication and General Office Administration



Answer telephone calls, respond to routine inquiries, and direct calls to the appropriate department.



Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence,
s, faxes, and electronic documents.



Maintain office supplies, administrative forms, filing systems, and staff records.



Assist with preparing reports, spreadsheets, meeting materials, and operational tracking logs.



Provide professional customer service to patients, families, referral partners, physicians, and employees.



Perform other administrative duties as assigned.



Qualifications and Requirements



High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or relevant administrative training preferred.



One to two years of healthcare administrative experience preferred.



Home health agency experience strongly preferred.



Familiarity with Medicare-certified home health operations and clinical documentation workflows preferred.



Experience with electronic medical record systems, such as CradleMRX , or similar platforms, preferred.



Basic knowledge of medical terminology, HIPAA, insurance verification, and healthcare billing processes.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office,
, spreadsheets, and electronic filing systems.



Strong organizational, communication, time-management, and problem-solving skills.



Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.



High level of accuracy, professionalism, confidentiality, and accountability.



Performance Expectations

We are looking for an experienced Graphic Designer to join our growing creative team. You will play a key role in delivering high-quality visual assets across a wide range of client projects, supporting recruitment brands at different stages of growth.

We are not looking for generic, templated design output. We want someone with a strong eye, clear creative opinions, awareness of trends, and evidence of this in their portfolio.



You will be joining a growing Philippines-based function that is increasingly central to the success of the wider agency, working from home, with in-person meetups twice a year for collaboration and celebrations. You should be reasonably accessible to Manila for these.



What you'll do

--------------------

Design and creative delivery:



- Create high-quality visual assets across print and digital channels, including social media, presentations, brochures, and branded documents

- Design logos and visual identities in line with client briefs and brand guidelines

- Produce assets for both organic and campaign-based marketing activity

- Use AI tools where they add value, for example in ideation, mock-ups, image editing and producing asset variations, applying your own judgement to every output

- Ensure all creative work meets brand, quality, and accessibility standards



Collaboration and communication:



- Work closely with account managers and the creative team to understand briefs, objectives, and timelines

- Clearly communicate design concepts and rationale to internal stakeholders

- Participate in feedback and iteration cycles, refining designs based on client and internal input

- Share what you learn about new tools and techniques, helping shape how the creative team works



Brand and quality control:



- Maintain consistency across all client brand touchpoints

- Apply strong design thinking to solve visual communication challenges

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritising workloads effectively and flagging capacity issues when required



How we use AI:

We use AI to work smarter, not to replace creative thinking. You will be encouraged to explore and adopt AI tools that speed up production, unlock new ideas and raise the quality of what we deliver, while your eye, judgement and craft stay at the heart of the work. We are looking for someone who:



- Is curious about AI and actively experiments with new tools and techniques

- Can use AI tools (e.g. Adobe Firefly, Photoshop Generative Fill, Canva AI, Midjourney or similar) to support ideation, asset creation and image editing

- Applies strong creative judgement to AI output, knowing when to use it, when to refine it and when not to use it at all

- Uses AI responsibly, respecting client confidentiality, brand guidelines and intellectual property



You do not need to be an expert. We care more about curiosity and a willingness to learn than about knowing every tool.



What you'll bring

-----------------------

Essential:



- Design capabilities. You must be confident creating:

- Social media assets for multiple platforms (including LinkedIn)

- Brochures and professionally designed documents

- A wide range of print and digital assets (e.g. event banners, business cards,
 signatures)

- PowerPoint presentations

- Logos and visual identity elements



Skills:



- Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, layout, and composition

- Strong written and spoken English, demonstrated through qualifications or professional experience

- Clear and confident communication, including explaining and justifying design decisions to non-design stakeholders

- Excellent time management and organisational ability, comfortable in a fast-paced agency environment with multiple concurrent briefs

- A growth mindset and a genuine interest in developing your skills with AI and emerging tools



Tools:



- Adobe Creative Suite (particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign)

- Canva

- Microsoft 365 (particularly Word and PowerPoint)



Nice to have. Experience in the following would be an advantage, but is not required:



- Animation

- Photo editing (e.g. headshots, office photography)

- Video editing (e.g. podcasts, social media clips)

- Newsletters and landing pages

- Brand design and development

- Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects

- A strong point of view on design and creative direction

- Awareness of current design trends and the ability to apply them appropriately

- Evidence of continued professional development



If you are developing skills in any of the above, we welcome examples of self-led learning or practical application.



About you

---------------

We are looking for someone who is:

- Collaborative and team-oriented

- Confident but not ego-driven, with strong creative judgement and pride in producing thoughtful, considered work

- Trustworthy and dependable

- Proactive in communicating workload and challenges

- Motivated to grow with the business as we continue to expand, and to keep evolving your skills as the industry and its tools change



Your portfolio

-------------------

A strong portfolio demonstrating a range of design work is essential. It should show more than basic layout work: we are looking for evidence of concept development, visual judgement, and considered design thinking.



Examples of AI-assisted work are welcome. If you include any, add a short note on your process and how you used AI alongside your own design skills.



What we offer

-------------------

- Fully remote working

- Structured contractor engagement with paid public holidays, annual leave, and sick leave entitlement

- A collaborative and supportive team environment

- Exposure to a wide variety of global recruitment brands

- Opportunities to develop skills across branding, campaigns, and emerging tools, including AI

- Support and time to build your AI skills, experimenting and learning alongside the team

- Mentoring and professional support

- Twice-yearly in-person team meetups



Kitto is committed to maintaining fair and transparent holiday and sickness policies that support work/life balance and wellbeing across our global team.

title: Data Intake & Inventory Manager
description:
Maryah is a data company that works with established businesses to license their operational data to AI companies. We collect business data like CRM records, project management workflows, finance system exports, and internal documents, prepare it, and match it with buyers who use it to train AI models.



The role:

We’re looking for someone to own data intake once a business has agreed to work with us. You’ll make sure we collect the right data, in the right format, and that everything is properly documented in our inventory. Think of it as being an inventory manager, except the inventory is datasets.



What you’ll do:

- Take over from our partnerships team once a business has agreed to work with us

- Guide the business through what to export and how, with clear checklists and follow-ups

- Review incoming data for completeness, quality, and format issues

- Clean, structure, and organize datasets so they’re consistent and easy to review

- Maintain our central inventory sheet: software source, data type, file format, volume, industry, geography, date range, and status

- Flag personal or sensitive information so it can be anonymized before licensing

- Prepare short dataset summaries our team can share with buyers

- Keep intake records and documentation up to date



What we’re looking for:

- 2+ years in a data, operations, or database role

- Working knowledge of SQL and Python for querying, cleaning, and transforming data

- Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills (filters, lookups, pivot tables)

- Comfortable working with files like CSV, XLSX, and JSON

- Familiar with common business tools (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, Asana, QuickBooks, Google Drive)

- Very detail-oriented and organized; you notice when something is missing or doesn’t add up

- Clear written English, since you’ll be guiding business owners through exports

- Can work independently and follow a process without being chased



Nice to have:

Experience with data cataloging or database management

Understanding of data privacy and handling sensitive information

Experience with large datasets (millions of rows)



To apply, send:

Your resume

A quick description of how you’d use SQL or Python to clean a messy CSV export with duplicate rows and missing fields



Include “INVENTORY” in your subject line so we know you read the post.

title: US SENIOR ACCOUNTANT
description:
# NOW HIRING: SENIOR US ACCOUNTANT – MULTI-CLIENT ACCOUNTING & QUALITY CONTROL



**Remote / Offshore Position | US-Based Bookkeeping & Tax Firm**



**REQUIRED: Minimum 4 Years of Verifiable US Accounting Experience | 4–7+ Years Preferred**



We are an established US-based bookkeeping and tax firm seeking a highly experienced **Senior US Accountant** to join our offshore team.



This is a senior-level position requiring strong US GAAP knowledge, extensive QuickBooks Online experience, and the ability to independently manage multiple US business clients.



**Our priority is finding an accountant who can REVIEW, VERIFY, IDENTIFY ERRORS, and CORRECT accounting work—not someone who only performs basic bookkeeping or data entry.**



We are looking for a **self-starter who takes initiative, works independently, and requires minimal supervision.** While management actively monitors workflow, assignments, productivity, and deadlines through our practice management system, we expect our accountants to take full ownership of their responsibilities without constant reminders or direction.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



 1. Accounting Review & Quality Control



- Review, verify, and properly classify transactions for multiple US business clients.

- Perform extensive quality-control reviews of bookkeeping completed by other team members.

- Identify and correct errors, duplicate transactions, misclassifications, and reconciliation discrepancies.

- Review general ledgers, journal entries, bank and credit card reconciliations, and financial statements.

- Prepare and review monthly Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

- Perform month-end and year-end closing procedures.

- Ensure compliance with US GAAP accounting standards.



 2. US Payroll Processing



- Process weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, and monthly payroll.

- Verify employee hours, overtime, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll adjustments.

- Review payroll tax liabilities and reporting requirements.

- Handle payroll reconciliations, corrections, garnishments, and workers' compensation reporting.

- Work with Gusto, ADP, and other US payroll systems.



3. US Tax Processing & California Sales Tax



- Assist with preparation and review of US individual and business tax returns.

- Review supporting tax documents for accuracy and completeness.

-Assist with 1099 reporting.

- Prepare California sales and use tax reports (CDTFA).

- Reconcile taxable sales, nontaxable sales, and sales tax liabilities.

- Assist with quarterly and annual tax reporting.

- Coordinate missing information and tax-related discrepancies.



 4. Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



- Manage customer invoicing, vendor bills, and payment records.

- Review AP/AR aging reports.

- Reconcile vendor statements and customer accounts.

- Monitor outstanding balances and payment discrepancies.

- Ensure accurate financial documentation and timely billing.



5. Construction Accounting & Administrative Support



- Prepare construction billing, estimates, bids, and change orders.

- Track job costs, labor expenses, subcontractor payments, and project profitability.

- Review construction-related invoices and expense allocations.

- Assist with project billing and administrative accounting responsibilities.

- Maintain organized project records and supporting documentation.



 6. Multi-Client Management & Workflow Accountability



- Independently manage multiple US business clients with competing deadlines.

- Organize and prioritize daily assignments without constant supervision.

- Proactively identify pending work, missing documentation, and approaching deadlines.

- Maintain accurate task statuses and progress updates in the firm's workflow management system.

- Complete assigned work within established deadlines and quality standards.

- Communicate proactively when issues arise rather than waiting for management to follow up.

- Take ownership of assigned client accounts from start to completion.

- Maintain strict confidentiality of client financial information.



 WORK ENVIRONMENT & EXPECTATIONS



**This is a remote position with structured workflow monitoring, but it is NOT a micromanaged role.**



Our firm uses a practice management system to monitor assignments, progress, productivity, and deadlines. However, we expect our team members to manage their daily responsibilities independently.



The ideal candidate must:



- **Be a self-starter:** Take initiative and identify what needs to be done without waiting for instructions.

- **Work independently:** Be capable of completing complex accounting assignments with minimal supervision.

- **Take ownership:** Be responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of assigned work.

- **Stay organized:** Manage multiple clients, projects, and deadlines efficiently.

- **Be proactive:** Identify and resolve accounting issues before they become larger problems.

- **Be accountable:** Keep workflow statuses updated and communicate progress or delays promptly.

- **Be resourceful:** Research accounting questions, troubleshoot discrepancies, and recommend solutions independently.

- **Accept accountability:** Be comfortable working in an environment where workflow, deadlines, and work quality are regularly reviewed.



**We provide clear expectations, organized workflows, and management support when needed. We do not provide constant reminders or step-by-step supervision for routine responsibilities.**



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



- **Minimum 4 years of verifiable hands-on US accounting experience, with 4–7+ years preferred.**

- Strong knowledge and practical application of **US GAAP**.

- Advanced proficiency in **QuickBooks Online**.

- Proven experience managing multiple US business clients.

- Extensive experience reviewing, correcting, and reconciling accounting records.

- Hands-on experience processing US payroll.

- Working knowledge of US tax reporting and preparation support.

- Strong AP/AR, general ledger, and financial statement preparation experience.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Proven ability to work remotely, independently, and productively.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

- Exceptional attention to detail, accountability, and problem-solving abilities.



## PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Previous employment with a US-based CPA, accounting, or bookkeeping firm.

- California CDTFA sales tax reporting.

- ProConnect Tax Online.

- Gusto and ADP payroll systems.

- Construction accounting, job costing, and progress billing.

- Experience reviewing or supervising junior accounting staff.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent professional qualifications.



## MANDATORY ACCOUNTING ASSESSMENT



**All shortlisted applicants must pass a practical accounting assessment before proceeding to the final interview.**



The assessment will evaluate:



1. **US GAAP:** Accruals, adjusting entries, and proper accounting treatment.

2. **QuickBooks Online:** Transaction classification, reconciliations, and error detection.

3. **Quality Control:** Identifying and correcting mistakes in sample financial records.

4. **US Payroll:** Payroll calculations, deductions, liabilities, and reconciliations.

5. **Financial Statements:** Reviewing Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

6. **Independent Problem-Solving:** Resolving accounting discrepancies without step-by-step instructions.

7. **Workflow Management:** Prioritizing multiple client assignments and meeting deadlines independently.



**A minimum passing score of 80% is required.**



## IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT QUALIFIED



**We are NOT hiring an entry-level accountant, basic bookkeeper, or data-entry specialist.**



Please do not apply if:



- You have fewer than 4 years of actual US accounting experience.

- Your experience is limited to non-US accounting.

- You only have basic QuickBooks transaction-entry experience.

- You cannot independently reconcile accounts and review financial statements.

- You lack practical US GAAP knowledge.

- You require constant supervision, repeated reminders, or daily step-by-step instructions.

- You are uncomfortable with workflow tracking, deadline monitoring, and accountability.

- You cannot independently manage multiple clients and competing deadlines.

- You are unwilling to complete a practical accounting assessment.



**Applicants who do not meet the minimum requirements will not be considered.**



## HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your updated resume along with:



1. Total years of hands-on US accounting experience.

2. Years of QuickBooks Online experience.

3. Number and types of US business clients you have managed simultaneously.

4. Experience with US payroll, tax preparation, and California sales tax.

5. Experience reviewing and correcting other accountants' or bookkeepers' work.

6. Experience with construction accounting and job costing.

7. Experience working independently in a remote accounting position.

8. Expected monthly salary in USD.

9. Earliest available start date.



**Only qualified candidates with verifiable US accounting experience will be contacted.**



We are seeking a dependable, experienced, long-term professional who takes initiative, works independently, catches mistakes before they become problems, and consistently delivers accurate financial reporting.



**If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this position is not the right fit. If you are an experienced US accountant who takes ownership, solves problems, and delivers results independently, we encourage you to apply.**



Compensation depends on qualifications and the working schedule is 9:00 am to 6:00 pm Monday through Friday US Time zone.  During tax season we do work longer hours.

• Structured extraction of candidate information from résumés and interviews.

• Evidence-based candidate recommendations with clear explanations.

• Scoring approaches grounded in defined, job-relevant criteria.

s directly within HIRALO and manage conversation history within candidate profiles.

This is a high-impact "Player-Coach" position. In the initial phase, you will be hands-on managing daily operations—sourcing trade suppliers, chasing compliance documentation, driving job activations, and handling phone support and escalations for both UK clients (property managers) and contractors. As order volumes scale over the coming months, you will recruit, train, and lead a dedicated team of offshore dispatch and support agents underneath you.



Key Responsibilities



1. 

End-to-End Supplier Lifecycle Management (Sourcing to Activation)

Outreach & Sourcing: Proactively contact UK trade contractors (plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, etc.) to introduce them to the Keylr platform. 

Compliance & Onboarding Vetting: Chase missing compliance documentation (Public Liability Insurance, bank/VAT details, trade certifications) via assertive outbound calls and follow-ups.

Supplier Activation: Guide contractors through app registration, train them on accepting work orders, and drive their initial job completions at established rate cards.



2.

s, and tickets for both UK Property Managers (clients) and Service Suppliers.

Priority Escalation Management: Resolve high-priority issues (e.g., contractor no-shows, urgent client escalations, SLA breaches, billing queries) over the phone with speed and professionalism.

 templates, macro responses, and ticket routing rules in Zendesk/Freshdesk.Metric Tracking: Monitor and improve core operational KPIs: Supplier Onboarding Turnaround, Job Activation Rates, First Contact Resolution (FCR), and CSAT.



4. 

Team Building & Scaling (Phase 2 - Upcoming Months) 

Recruitment & Onboarding: Source, interview, hire, and train junior dispatch and customer support agents as platform volumes expand.

Direct Supervision: Provide day-to-day management, quality assurance (QA) audits, schedule adherence, and active performance coaching for your team.



Candidate Qualifications & Requirements



Team Leadership Experience: Minimum 2+ years managing a team of at least 10 direct reports (10+ pax) as a Call Center Team Lead, Customer Support Supervisor, or Operations Lead supporting Western (UK/US) accounts.



Assertive Spoken English: Exceptional, highly articulate spoken English with a neutral accent—you must be confident handling calls with both UK corporate clients (property managers) and trade contractors.



Full-Funnel Phone Operations: Strong background in handling inbound client support, high-volume outbound phone outreach, and vendor/supplier management.Tech & Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with cloud VoIP tools (Aircall, RingCentral), ticketing platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot), and dispatch/ERP software.



Hardware & Home Office Requirements (Mandatory) Own Laptop/PC: Personal laptop or desktop computer with high-performance specifications (Minimum Intel i5/AMD Ryzen 5 or higher, 8GB+ RAM) capable of handling cloud telephony software, multiple browser tabs, and CRM tools concurrently. Noise-Canceling Headset: High-quality USB noise-canceling headset for clear, professional phone communications.



Reliable High-Speed Internet: Minimum 50+ Mbps fiber internet connection with low latency.Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or power station/generator backup to ensure zero downtime during mid-shift power outages.



Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office setup free from background noise.



What We Offer



Flat Monthly Compensation: $1,200 USD flat monthly contractor rate paid once per month.



Fixed Mid-Shift Schedule: Monday to Friday, UK business hours (No weekend shifts).



100% Remote Work: Save 3–4 hours of daily Manila commute time and work comfortably from home.



Career Growth: Direct path to build, recruit, and lead Keylr’s dedicated Philippine operational hub as the business scales.



Recruitment Process



Stage 1 — Application & Voice Audit: Review of CV, equipment specs, and voice introduction link.

Stage 2 — Initial Video Interview (30 mins): Discussion on phone confidence, client call handling, supplier management, and 10+ pax leadership experience.

Stage 3 — Practical Case Study (30 mins): A brief, real-world exercise simulating UK client/supplier outreach and workflow design.

Stage 4 — Final Leadership Interview & Offer: Final alignment with UK Executive Leadership.



How to Apply (Mandatory Instructions)

title: Client Success Assistant (Phone + Text Heavy), US Growth Agency, Full Time, $500/month + bonus
description:
Systemize is a US growth agency for med spas. We fill their calendars with Botox and filler patients. We are a small team, and we need one person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks: every lead followed up, every client set up on time, every loose end closed.



This is a phone and text heavy role. You will talk to med spa owners and managers every day, so your spoken English has to be excellent.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Follow up on our leads until they book or say no. Med spa owners who asked about our service get a call and a text from you, on our follow-up schedule, until they book a call with us or tell us no. Every lead, every time. You don't sell. You book the call and our team does the rest.

2. Get our new clients set up. When a med spa signs, we need logins and information from them (ad account, booking system, prices, their past patient list). You track what's missing and follow up by phone, text and
 until we have everything, usually within the first 3 days.

3. Keep clients happy. A short weekly check-in call or text with each client, notes in the CRM, and anything they need passed to the right person on our team.

4. Admin. Keep the CRM clean and up to date, book meetings on our calendar, and keep the task list moving.



PAY

- $500 per month base, paid monthly.

- Plus $25 for every sales call you book that shows up. No cap.



HOURS

Full time, 40 hours a week: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM US Central Time, when med spa owners and their front desks pick up. Only apply if you can work these hours every week.



START

Mid-November 2026, after a paid 1-week trial.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English: clear, confident and friendly with US business owners.

- Organized: you keep a list, you follow up on time, and you never let a task go quiet.

- A quiet, private room for calls, internet of at least 25 Mbps with a backup, a computer and a headset.

- Comfortable with a CRM, Google Calendar,
 and a web phone.

- A plus: customer success, account management, executive assistant, or appointment setting for a US company.



HOW TO APPLY (we only review applications that follow every step)

1. Subject line, exactly: CLIENT SUCCESS - [Your full name]

2. A voice recording, 60 to 90 seconds, shared as a link anyone can open, recorded on your work headset:

   - First, about 45 seconds: tell us about yourself and a job where you followed up with customers or clients.

   - Then leave this voi
 as if it were real: Maria owns a med spa and signed with us yesterday. We still need access to her booking system to launch next week. Leave her a voi
 asking for it (15 to 30 seconds).

3. A short written answer. A med spa owner who asked about our service two weeks ago texts back: "Sorry, been crazy busy. What was this about again?" Write the text you would send back, in 2 to 4 sentences.

4. Answer these in your message:

   1. Your full name, city and country.

   2. Can you work Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM US Central Time, every week?

   3. Your follow-up or client-facing experience: where, how long, what you did.

   4. Which CRMs and tools have you used?

   5. Your internet speed (paste a speedtest.net result) and your backup.

   6. Do you have another job now? Will this be your only full-time job?

   7. When can you start?

   8. Are you comfortable with $500 per month base plus $25 per sales call booked that shows up?



Applications without the subject line, the recording and the written answer are not reviewed.

title: YouTube Video Editor for Golf Content (Long-Form, Ongoing Work)

Color correct and balance audio across multiple cameras and mics

title: Game Playtester (Windows PC) — Educational Coding Game — Recorded Think-Aloud Sessions, Part-Time Gig
description:
We are Ironline Games, a small US indie studio. We are hiring four part-time playtesters for our educational adventure game White Hat Academy, which teaches complete beginners to code through story missions with a built-in terminal.



This is a gig, not full-time work: roughly 4–6 paid hours per tester over about two weeks, on your own schedule, with the possibility of repeat work on future builds for testers who do great work.



What you will do:

1. Complete a short paid screening exercise ($10 flat, about 60–90 minutes) — details below.

2. Play the game on your Windows PC while recording your screen and your voice (you will talk out loud about what you're thinking as you play — this is called think-aloud testing, and it is the whole point of the job).

3. Fill out a feedback form after each session and report any bugs you find, using our simple template.



Requirements — please read all of them:

- A Windows 10 or 11 PC and a microphone (headset is fine). Sessions are recorded with free software (we'll tell you exactly what to use).

- You must NOT know how to code. We are specifically looking for beginners for three of the four slots — if you are a programmer, this gig is not for you (that's a compliment, not an insult). One slot is for someone with game QA or software testing experience; say which slot you are applying for.

- Strong spoken and written English — you will be narrating your thoughts and writing feedback in English.

- Reliable internet (recordings are large files you'll upload after each session).

- Bonus (tell us if it applies): you own an iPhone (any model running a current iOS). iPhone owners may get extra paid sessions testing our iOS build. If you have one, include the model and iOS version in your application.

- OnlineJobs ID Proof score of 80 or higher.



Pay: $5/hour for playtester slots, $7/hour for the QA slot (screening exercise paid separately at $10 flat, whether or not you are hired for sessions). Paid via Wise within 48 hours of each accepted delivery.



How to apply — follow these steps exactly (applications that skip a step will not be read):

1. Start your application with the word HAT so we know you read the whole post.

2. Tell us: (a) which slot you're applying for (Beginner or QA); (b) your PC specs (Windows version, CPU, RAM); (c) whether you own an iPhone, and if so the model + iOS version; (d) two or three games you've played recently; (e) for the QA slot only: one example of testing work you've done.

3. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to the paid screening exercise. You will never be asked to pay anything, buy anything, or install anything suspicious — the screening uses a video we provide and a writing task.



We reply to every correctly-submitted application within 5 days.

title: Community Appointment Setter – Women’s Health & Fitness
description:
COMMUNITY APPOINTMENT SETTER – WOMEN’S HEALTH & FITNESS



Fierce Women Community is looking for a warm, proactive and results-driven appointment setter to support our online fitness and coaching community for women over 40.



This role primarily involves written conversations: building trust, understanding women’s goals, following up thoughtfully and guiding suitable prospects toward consultation calls.



We’re looking for someone who combines genuine compassion with the initiative and confidence to achieve booking goals.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Build relationships with community members and prospective clients through personalized messages.

• Identify suitable prospects and book qualified consultation calls.

• Follow up consistently without making women feel pressured, spammed or harassed.

• Use scripts as guidance while keeping conversations natural and responsive.

• Work toward weekly qualified-booking goals.

• Show initiative during slower shifts by reviewing outstanding conversations, identifying opportunities and suggesting ways to improve results.

• Maintain accurate CRM notes, follow-up tasks and appointment records.

• Support appointment confirmations and reminders.

• Communicate clearly with our team and provide organized shift handovers.

• Respond to messages and comments across
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.



REQUIREMENTS



• Excellent written English with natural conversational fluency.

• Clear spoken English for team meetings and training.

• Strong empathy, listening skills and the ability to establish trust and rapport.

• A genuine interest in women’s health and fitness.

• Understanding of the challenges women may experience during perimenopause and menopause, or a strong willingness to learn.

• Organized, reliable and proactive, with consistent follow-through.

• Comfortable working toward booking goals while maintaining thoughtful, respectful conversations.

• Able to learn CRM systems quickly and maintain accurate records.

• Coachable and willing to apply feedback.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and a backup plan for disruptions.

• Respect for confidentiality and appropriate boundaries around health advice.



Appointment-setting experience is a strong advantage. Experience in women’s health, fitness or online coaching is especially valuable.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



Our community operates between 6 a.m. and 10 p.m. Edmonton, Canada time. You’ll share coverage with two other front-end team members.



Our proposed coverage schedule is:

• Monday–Friday: 6–9 a.m. and 2–5 p.m.

• Sunday: 1–3:30 p.m.

• Saturday off.

• One hour of weekly training/team meeting.



This totals approximately 33.5 hours per week, including training.



This schedule is a starting suggestion and is open to discussion. We can coordinate shifts with our existing team to find a consistent arrangement that works for both you and the community. Responsibilities and response-time expectations during coverage will be agreed before starting.



Please include your availability in Edmonton time and indicate whether you’re comfortable with split shifts. Times follow Edmonton’s daylight-saving changes.



STARTING COMPENSATION



• CAD $150 monthly base.

• CAD $2 commission per qualified consultation booked.

• Initial one-month paid trial, including training on our community, scripts, programs and systems.

• Compensation review after three months, with the possibility of increasing the base to CAD $200/month and commission to CAD $2.50 per qualified booking.

• Further commission growth may be considered as consistent, quality results develop.



Increases depend on performance and business capacity and are not guaranteed. Qualified-booking criteria and payment terms will be agreed before starting.



During the initial training period, we’ll assess reliability, communication, accuracy and progress alongside booking results.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and why this role interests you.

2. Your relevant experience, including any appointment-setting results.

3. Your experience or interest in women’s health, menopause, fitness or coaching.

4. The social platforms and CRM systems you have used.

5. Your availability, time zone and preferred weekly schedule.

6. Confirmation that you understand the starting compensation is in Canadian dollars and are comfortable discussing the role within that budget.

7. A short sample reply to this community member:



“I’ve tried eating healthy and exercising, but my belly fat won’t budge. I’m frustrated and don’t know what to do.”



We’ll provide training on our approach. For this sample, we’re interested in your natural communication style, empathy and ability to keep a conversation going.

title: Sales Representative

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

description:

If you understand what makes people click on a video, have a strong eye for design, and love golf (or are willing to learn it), we want to hear from you.



What you will do:



Design eye-catching YouTube thumbnails for golf videos (lessons, course vlogs, playing videos, product reviews, and challenges)

Cut out people and products cleanly from photos and video frames

Use bold, easy-to-read text (3 to 5 words max) that works on mobile

Use color, contrast, facial expressions, and arrows or circles to drive clicks

Create 2 versions of each thumbnail for A/B testing

Match each client’s brand colors, fonts, and style

Deliver on time and take feedback well

Communicate clearly with our project manager



What we are looking for:



At least 2 years of YouTube thumbnail design experience

A portfolio of thumbnails you have designed (golf or sports content is a big plus)

Strong skills in Photoshop (Canva or Figma is a plus)

Understanding of click-through rate (CTR) and what makes thumbnails perform

Golf knowledge or a willingness to learn golf terms and culture

Good English communication and the ability to take feedback

Fast turnaround (24 to 48 hours per thumbnail)



Details:



Remote, ongoing contractor role

Pay: [your rate here] per thumbnail (includes 2 versions)

Workload: [number of thumbnails per week or month]

Room to grow as we add more clients



How to apply:



Send a link to your thumbnail portfolio (at least 10 thumbnails)

Tell us your design software and your typical turnaround time per thumbnail

Start your application with the words “Birdie Ready” so we know you read this post



Applicants who skip any of these steps will not be considered.
